For the sake of the unification of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Divine Presence, in reverence and love, to unify the name *Yod-Heh* with *Vav-Heh* in perfect unity in the name of all Israel.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Tallit 4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Tallit/r/4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Tallit/r/4)


הֲרֵֽינִי מִתְעַטֵּף בַּצִּיצִית. כֵּן תִּתְעַטֵּף נִשְׁמָתִי וּרְמַ״ח אֵבָרַי וּשְׁסָ״ה גִידַי בְּאוֹר הַצִּיצִית הָעוֹלָה תַּרְיַ״ג. וּכְשֵׁם שֶׁאֲנִי מִתְכַּסֶּה בְּטַלִּית בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה, כָּךְ אֶזְכֶּה לַחֲלוּקָא דְרַבָּנָן וּלְטַלִּית נָאָה לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא בְּגַן עֵֽדֶן. וְעַל יְדֵי מִצְוַת צִיצִית תִּנָּצֵל נַפְשִׁי רוּחִי וְנִשְׁמָתִי וּתְפִלָּתִי מִן הַחִיצוֹנִים. וְהַטַּלִּית תִּפְרֹשׂ כְּנָפֶֽיהָ עֲלֵיהֶם וְתַצִּילֵם, כְּנֶֽשֶׁר יָעִיר קִנּוֹ, עַל גּוֹזָלָיו יְרַחֶף: וּתְהֵא חֲשׁוּבָה מִצְוַת צִיצִית לִפְנֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, כְּאִלּוּ קִיַּמְתִּֽיהָ בְּכָל פְּרָטֶֽיהָ וְדִקְדּוּקֶֽיהָ וְכַוָּנוֹתֶֽיהָ וְתַרְיַ״ג מִצְוֹת הַתְּלוּיוֹת בָּהּ, אָמֵן סֶֽלָה.


I am about to wrap myself in this tasseled garment (tallit). So may my soul, my 248 limbs and 365 sinews be wrapped in the light of the tassel (*hatzitzit*) which amounts to 613 [commandments]. And just as I cover myself with a tasseled garment in this world, so may I be worthy of rabbinical dress and a fine garment in the World to Come in the Garden of Eden. Through the commandment of tassels may my life’s-breath, spirit, soul and prayer be delivered from external impediments, and may the tallit spread its wings over them like an eagle stirring up its nest, hovering over its young. May the commandment of the tasseled garment be considered before the Holy One, blessed be He, as if I had fulfilled it in all its specifics, details and intentions, as well as the 613 commandments dependent on it, Amen, Selah.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Tallit/r/8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Tallit/r/8)


מַה־יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹהִים, וּבְנֵי אָדָם בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶֽיךָ יֶחֱסָיוּן׃ יִרְוְיֻן מִדֶּֽשֶׁן בֵּיתֶֽךָ, וְנַֽחַל עֲדָנֶֽיךָ תַשְׁקֵם׃ כִּי־עִמְּךָ מְקוֹר חַיִּים, בְּאוֹרְךָ נִרְאֶה־אוֹר׃ מְשֹׁךְ חַסְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶֽיךָ, וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃


מַה־יָּקָר How precious is Your loving-kindness, O God, and the children of men find refuge under the shadow of Your wings. They are filled with the rich plenty of Your House. You give them drink from Your river of delights. For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light, we see light. Continue Your loving-kindness to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.



### Preparation for Prayer

###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Preparation for Prayer 2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Preparation%20for%20Prayer/r/2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Preparation%20for%20Prayer/r/2)


מַה־טֹּֽבוּ
אֹהָלֶֽיךָ יַעֲקֹב, מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶֽיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶֽךָ
אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁךָ
בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃
יהוה אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶֽךָ
וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃


How goodly
are your tents, Jacob, your dwelling places, Israel.
As for me,
in Your great loving-kindness,
I will come into Your House.
I will bow down to Your holy Temple
in awe of You.
LORD, I love the habitation of Your House,
the place where Your glory dwells.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Preparation for Prayer 3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Preparation%20for%20Prayer/r/3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Preparation%20for%20Prayer/r/3)


וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה
וְאֶכְרָֽעָה
אֶבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי יהוה עֹשִׂי.


As for me,
I will bow in worship;
I will bend the knee
before the LORD my Maker.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Preparation for Prayer 4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Preparation%20for%20Prayer/r/4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Preparation%20for%20Prayer/r/4)


וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יהוה
עֵת רָצוֹן
אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּֽךָ
עֲנֵֽנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ׃


As for me,
may my prayer come to You, LORD,
at a time of favor.
God, in Your great loving-kindness,
answer me with Your faithful salvation.

###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/22)


*קהל:* כִּי הִרְבֵּֽיתָ טוֹבוֹת אֵלַי / כִּי הִגְדַּֽלְתָּ חַסְדְּךָ עָלָי.


*Cong:* For You have heaped good upon me, / and Your kindness to me has been great.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/23)


*ש״ץ:* וְרַב שִׁלּוּמִים, לְךָ חֻיָּֽבְתִּי / כִּי עָשִֽׂיתָ טוֹבוֹת אִתִּי.


*Leader:* And many a debt have I incurred toward You, / for You have done good with me;


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/24)


*קהל:* וְלֹא חֻיַּֽבְתָּ לִי גְּמוּלֶֽיךָ / כָּל טוֹבָתִי בַּל עָלֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* Yet You do not ask me my debt to You, / all Your goodness to me is due to Your benevolence alone.
for


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/25)


*ש״ץ:* עַל הַטּוֹבוֹת לֹא עֲבַדְתִּֽיךָ / אַחַת לְרִבֹּא לֹא גְמַלְתִּֽיךָ.


*Leader:* I have not sufficiently worshiped You for all of this good; / I have not repaid You even one part of ten thousand.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/26)


*קהל:* אִם אָמַֽרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָה נָּא, כְמוֹ / לֹא יָדַֽעְתִּי סְפֹרוֹת לָֽמוֹ.


*Cong:* If I tried to count the good You have done, / I would not know how to learn its number.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/27)


*ש״ץ:* וּמָה אָשִׁיב לְךָ, וְהַכֹּל שֶׁלָּךְ / לְךָ שָׁמַֽיִם, אַף אֶֽרֶץ לָךְ.


*Leader:* And what shall I give back to You? All is Yours! / The heavens are Yours as well as the earth.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/28)


*קהל:* יַמִּים וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בָּם, בְּיָדֶֽךָ / וְכֻלָּם יִשְׂבְּעוּן מִיָּדֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* The seas and all that is within are in Your hands; / all receive nourishment from Your hand.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/29)


*ש״ץ:* וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ עַמְּךָ וְצֹאנֶֽךָ / וַחֲפֵצִים לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* And we are Your nation, Your flock, / who desire to perform Your will!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/30)


*קהל:* וְאֵיךְ נַעֲבֹד וְאֵין לְאֵל יָדֵֽנוּ / וְלִשְׂרֵפַת אֵשׁ, בֵּית קָדְשֵֽׁנוּ.


*Cong:* And how shall we worship when we lack strength, / and our holy Temple has been consumed by fire?


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/31)


*ש״ץ:* וְאֵיךְ נַעֲבֹד, וְאֵין זֶֽבַח וּמִנְחָה / כִּי לֹא בָֽאנוּ אֶל הַמְּנוּחָה.


*Leader:* And how shall we worship now that peace-offerings and meal-offerings are no more – / for we have not yet come to that restful place [Jerusalem].


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/32)


*קהל:* וּמַֽיִם אַֽיִן לְהַעֲבִיר טֻמְאָה / וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ עַל אֲדָמָה טְמֵאָה.


*Cong:* And there is no water to wash away impurity; / and we are situated in an impure land.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/33)


*ש״ץ:* שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל אֲמָרֶֽיךָ / וַאֲנִי בָֽאתִי בִּדְבָרֶֽיךָ.


*Leader:* Your words render me joyous; / I have now come before You to follow Your utterances.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/34)


*קהל:* כִּי כָתוּב, לֹא עַל זְבָחֶֽיךָ / וְעוֹלֹתֶֽיךָ אוֹכִיחֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* For it is said: Not concerning your peace-offerings / and burnt-offerings will I rebuke you.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/35)


*ש״ץ:* עַל דְּבַר זֶֽבַח, וְעוֹלוֹתֵיכֶם / לֹא צִוִּֽיתִי אֶת אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם.


*Leader:* Concerning peace-offerings and burnt-offerings, / I did not command your ancestors.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/36)


*קהל:* מַה שָּׁאַֽלְתִּי וּמַה דָּרַֽשְׁתִּי / מִמְּךָ, כִּי אִם לְיִרְאָה אוֹתִי.


*Cong:* What have I asked and what have I required / of you? – only to fear Me!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/37)


*ש״ץ:* לַעֲבוֹד בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְלֵבָב טוֹב / הִנֵּה שְׁמֹֽעַ מִזֶּֽבַח טוֹב:


*Leader:* To worship Me with joy and a glad heart – / “For heeding Me is better than a choice sacrifice.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/38)


*קהל:* וְלֵב נִשְׁבָּר, מִמִּנְחָה טְהוֹרָה / זִבְחֵי אֱלֹהִים רֽוּחַ נִשְׁבָּרָה:


*Cong:* And a broken heart is better than a pure meal-offering; / a broken spirit is equivalent to a sacrifice to God.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/39)


*ש״ץ:* זֶֽבַח וּמִנְחָה לֹא־חָפַֽצְתָּ: / חַטָּאת וְעוֹלָה לֹא שָׁאָֽלְתָּ.


*Leader:* You do not desire peace-offerings and meal-offerings, / You did not request sin-offerings or burnt-offerings.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/40)


*קהל:* מִזְבֵּֽחַ אֶבְנֶה בְּשִׁבְרוֹן לִבִּי / וַאֲשַׁבְּרָה אַף רוּחִי בְּקִרְבִּי.


*Cong:* I shall build an altar out of my shattered heart, / and I shall break and humble my spirit within me.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/41)


*ש״ץ:* רוּם לֵב אַשְׁפִּיל, וְאֶת רוּם עֵינַי / וְאֶקְרַע לְבָבִי לְמַֽעַן אֲדֹנָי.


*Leader:* I shall bring low my haughty heart and lower my haughty eyes; / I shall rend my heart for the sake of my Lord.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/42)


*קהל:* שִׁבְרֵי רוּחִי הֵם זְבָחֶֽיךָ / יַעֲלוּ לְרָצוֹן עַל מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* The fragments of my spirit shall be Your offerings; / may they rise up to You upon Your altar and be willingly accepted.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/43)


*ש״ץ:* וְאַשְׁמִֽיעַ בְּקוֹל הוֹדָיוֹתֶֽיךָ / וַאֲסַפְּרָה כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ.


*Leader:* And I shall loudly sound out Your praise, / and recount of all Your wonders.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/44)


*קהל:* אֲשֶׁר יָדְעָה נַפְשִׁי אַחְבִּֽירָה / אֲמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת וַאֲדַבֵּֽרָה.


*Cong:* For that which my soul has known – I shall compose words, / I shall speak profusely of Your mighty deeds.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/45)


*ש״ץ:* וּמָה אֶעֱרוֹךְ, וְלֹא יָדַֽעְתִּי מָה / הֲיָכֹל אוּכַל דַּבֵּר מְאֽוּמָה:


*Leader:* And what shall I formulate when I do not know what to say? / Indeed, is there anything I can say?


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/46)


*קהל:* כִּי אֵין חֵֽקֶר לִגְדֻלָּתוֹ / וְגַם אֵין מִסְפָּר לִתְבוּנָתוֹ.


*Cong:* For His greatness , / His insight .
is unsearchable
innumerable


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/47)


*ש״ץ:* חֲכַם לֵבָב הוּא, מִי כָמֽוֹהוּ / שַׂגִּיא כֹֽחַ, לֹא מְצָאנֻֽהוּ.


*Leader:* He is wise of heart – who is like Him? / We shall never fully perceive the greatness of His strength.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/48)


*קהל:* עוֹשֶׂה גְדוֹלוֹת וְרַב נוֹרָאוֹת / גָּדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת:


*Cong:* The doer of great works; chief of awesome acts – / You are great, and You work wonders.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Sunday 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Sunday/r/49)


*ש״ץ:* עַד אֵין מִסְפָּר וְעַד אֵין חֵֽקֶר / וְלֹא נוֹדַע כִּי לֹא יֵחָקֵר.


*Leader:* Innumerable, – / their number shall never be known, for none shall succeed to discover their scope.
unsearchable

*Cong:* No side or edge limits You; / You are not split by width or length.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Monday 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Monday/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Monday/r/45)

*Leader:* No corners surround You, / no center splits You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Monday 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Monday/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Monday/r/46)

*Cong:* No wisdom shall ever truly know You; / no knowledge can ever reach understanding of You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Monday 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Monday/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Monday/r/47)

*Leader:* No knowledge can grasp You; / no mind can comprehend and know You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Monday 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Monday/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Monday/r/48)

*Cong:* All is from You, yet where are You? / How is it that You created all from nothing?

*Leader:* Indeed, I know that You, / the God of Jacob, created all things.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/2)


*קהל:* אַתָּה בוֹרֵא וְלֹא נִבְרֵֽאתָ / אַתָּה יוֹצֵר וְלֹא נוֹצָֽרְתָּ.


*Cong:* You are Creator but were not created; / You form every creature but You were not formed.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/3)

*Leader:* You bring death and shall consume all away; / You bring down to the grave and shall also bring out of it.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/4)

*Cong:* Faithful are You to revive the dead; / You have indeed made this known through Your prophets.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/5)

*Leader:* And You, O living God, shall not die, nor have You died; / You exist forever and ever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/6)

*Cong:* You bring babies to breach and give life, but You were not born; / You crush and heal but You have never been afflicted.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/7)

*Leader:* You know no death or pain; / Your eyes know not sleep or slumber.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/8)

*Cong:* For from the earliest days, You have been a living God; / You have not changed from what You have always been.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/9)

*Leader:* And You shall never change; / You shall never be degraded from Your divinity.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/10)

*Cong:* The terms “new” and “old” do not apply to You; / You initiated all but You were not initiated.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/11)

*Leader:* Old age and youth cannot be ascribed / to You; neither can hoariness or childhood.

*Cong:* Joy and sadness cannot be ascribed to You; / nor can the form of any creature or finite being.

*Leader:* For no material matter affects You; / You are unlike any creature or soul.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/14)

*Cong:* You surrounded each of Your creatures with boundaries; / their beginnings and ends are defined.

*Leader:* For You have placed boundaries for Your creatures; / You have surrounded the cycle of their lives with limits.

*Cong:* But You have no boundaries; neither do Your days, / Your years or Your great power.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/17)

*Leader:* Therefore, You need no one; / yet all beings need Your hand and Your kindness.

*Cong:* All require Your acts of righteousness, / yet You do not require Your creatures.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/19)

*Leader:* For before any creature, You existed / alone; You were in need of nothing.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Tuesday 20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/20)

*Cong:* All their beginnings and ends are arranged by Your hand; / You are within them and they are bound up with You.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/21)

*Cong:* All creatures and all their deeds, / their speech and all their thoughts;

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Tuesday/r/23)

*Leader:* From beginning to end You know all / and shall never forget; for You are near them.

*Leader:* He is the Lord, the God whose spirit dwells in all / flesh; He hears the prayers of all.

*קהל:* כַּגִּבּוֹר יֵצֵא כְּאִישׁ מִלְחָמוֹת / יָעִיר קִנְאָה לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמוֹת.


*Cong:* Like a hero He shall go forth like a man of war; / His jealousy shall be aroused to perform vengeance.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/31)


*ש״ץ:* כְּנֶֽשֶׁר, עַל כַּנְפֵי נְשָׁרִים / נָשָׂא עֲבָדָיו, וְיִשֵּׁר הֲדוּרִים.


*Leader:* Like an eagle upon eagles’ wings, / He has carried His servants and straightened crooked paths.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/32)


*קהל:* כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל וּכְנָמֵר שַֽׁחַל / כְּרָקָב וּכְעָשׁ, וְרוּחוֹ כַּנָּֽחַל.


*Cong:* Like a bereaved bear and a mighty leopard, / He shall reduce them to rottenness and moths; His spirit shall engulf them like an overflowing stream.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/33)


*ש״ץ:* כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל וּכְנָמֵר שׁוֹקֵד / דְּבָרוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּמַקֵּל שָׁקֵד.


*Leader:* He is like a bereaved bear and a diligent leopard, / carrying out His word like an almond branch quick to blossom.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/34)


*קהל:* כַּבִּיר כֹּֽחַ, לֵב כְּמוֹ שָֽׁחַל / כְּלָבִיא וְכַאֲרִי, וְרוּחוֹ כְּנָֽחַל.


*Cong:* Mighty of heart like a lion, / like a lion and a lioness, His spirit shall engulf them like an overflowing stream.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/35)


*ש״ץ:* כְּאֶֽרֶז בָּחוּר בִּגְדֻלָּתוֹ / כִּבְרוֹשׁ רַעֲנָן עַנְוְתָנוּתוֹ.


*Leader:* His greatness is as robust as a cedar tree; / His humility is likened to a flourishing cypress.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/36)


*קהל:* כְּתַפּֽוּחַ בְּרֵיחוֹ, עֹז אַהֲבָתוֹ / עַל עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ.


*Cong:* The boldness of His love is like a fragrant apple tree; / His glory is upon His people, Israel.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/37)


*ש״ץ:* כְּתַפּֽוּחַ בַּעֲצֵי הַיַּֽעַר / כֵּן דּוֹדִי עִם יוֹשְׁבֵי שָֽׁעַר.


*Leader:* As an apple tree among the trees of the forest, / so is my Beloved among the judges who sit at their gates.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/38)


*קהל:* כַּבִּיר כֹּֽחַ, לְמַרְגִּיזֵי אֵל / נוֹקֵם, וְכַטַּל הוּא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל.


*Cong:* Might and strength are displayed to those who anger the God / of vengeance; while He is as gentle as dew to His people, Israel.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/39)


*ש״ץ:* כּוֹסִי, מְנָת חֶלְקִי וְגוֹרָלִי / אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי נַחֲלָה וְדוֹדִי לִי.


*Leader:* He is my cup of blessing, the portion of my inheritance, my lot; / I am my Beloved’s inheritance and He is mine.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/40)


*קהל:* כְּבוֹדִי יהוה לֹא אֲמִירֶֽנּוּ / הֶאֱמַרְנֽוּהוּ וְהֶאֱמִירָֽנוּ.


*Cong:* Lord, I shall never relinquish my honor; / we have avowed ourselves to Him and He to us.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/41)


*ש״ץ:* כְּאַרְיֵה יִשְׁאַג וְכַכְּפִיר יִנְהַם / אַל יִהְיֶה כְּגֵר, וּכְאִישׁ נִדְהָם.


*Leader:* He shall roar and growl like a lion; / He will not be as a stranger, or a man astounded.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/42)


*קהל:* כְּרוֹעֶה גִּבּוֹר, אֲשֶׁר לֹא יוּכַל / צֹאנוֹ לְהַצִּיל, וְהָיָה לְמַאֲכָל.


*Cong:* He is not like a valiant shepherd unable / to rescue His flock, leaving it to be consumed.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/43)


*ש״ץ:* כְּגִבּוֹר אֵין אֱיָל, וּכְאוֹרֵֽחַ / נָס וּבוֹרֵֽחַ, מַר צוֹרֵֽחַ.


*Leader:* Not like a powerless man of valor or a passing wayfarer, / who flees and runs while screaming bitterly.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/44)


*קהל:* כְּאַרְיֵה מַשְׁחִית וְכַכְּפִיר לְעֹזְבָיו / כָּרָקָב גַּם כָּעָשׁ לְאוֹיְבָיו.


*Cong:* He is like a destructive young lion to those who forsake Him; / reducing His enemies to rottenness and moths.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/45)

*Leader:* Of mighty power, He will reduce them to thorns on thorn bushes; / not a single shake of an olive tree shall remain of them.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/46)


*קהל:* כְּשָׁמִיר וָשַֽׁיִת, צָרִים יְמַגֵּן / כְּצִפֳּרִים עָפוֹת לְעִירוֹ יָגֵן.


*Cong:* Like thorns on thorn bushes He shall deliver His foes to destruction; / He shall protect His city like birds hovering above.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/47)


*ש״ץ:* כְּגִשְׁמֵי נְדָבָה לָֽנוּ יָבֹא / כְּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְכַטַּל לַדְּבֵקִים בּוֹ.


*Leader:* He shall appear to us like generous rains; / He will be like the spring rain and the dew to those who cleave to Him.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/48)


*קהל:* כְּנֶֽשֶׁר יְרַחֵף עַל גּוֹזָלָיו / וּבְצֵל כְּנָפָיו יֶחֱסוּ מְיַחֲלָיו.


*Cong:* He shall hover above His young like an eagle; / those who await Him shall seek refuge beneath the shadow of His wings.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/49)


*ש״ץ:* כְּצִפֳּרִים, עַל עִירוֹ יָגֵן / וּבְצֵל כְּנָפָיו רְנָנוֹת נְנַגֵּן.


*Leader:* He shall protect His city like birds hovering above, / and in the shadow of His wings we shall play joyful songs.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/50)


*קהל:* לְבַדּוֹ הוּא, וְנִפְלָאוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת / עוֹשֶׂה אֵל נוֹרָא עֲלִילוֹת.


*Cong:* He is One alone and great wonders / He performs – God of awesome works.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/51)


*ש״ץ:* לִצְבִי וְעֹֽפֶר דּוֹמֶה דּוֹדִי / כִּי יְקַדְּמֵֽנִי אֱלֹהֵי חַסְדִּי.


*Leader:* My Beloved is like a gazelle and young hart; / My God of kindness hastens to receive me.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/52)


*קהל:* לִפְנֵי עַמּוֹ יְיַשֵּׁר הֲדוּרִים / וִינַשְּׂאֵם עַל כַּנְפֵי נְשָׁרִים.


*Cong:* He shall straighten crooked paths for His people, / and will lift them up upon eagles’ wings.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/53)


*ש״ץ:* לְעוֹלָם חֶלְקִי הוּא, וְצוּר לְבָבִי / כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי לְךָ וּלְבָבִי.


*Leader:* He shall always be my lot, the rock of my heart; / my heart and flesh long for You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 54

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/54](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/54)


*קהל:* לְבַדּוֹ יהוה הוּא, וְנִפְלָאוֹת / גְּדוֹלוֹת עוֹשֶׂה, וְרַב נוֹרָאוֹת.


*Cong:* Our Lord is alone; / He works great wonders and does many awesome things.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 55

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/55](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/55)


*ש״ץ:* מָקוֹם וּמָעוֹן לְעוֹלָמֶֽךָ / וְאֵין יוֹדֵֽעַ אֶת מְקוֹמֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* Your world has a place and dwelling, / yet no one knows Your dwelling place.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/56)


*קהל:* מוֹרָאִי, אֵל רוֹעִי וְיוֹצְרִי / צוּר יְלָדַֽנִי, מְחוֹלְלִי וְצוּרִי.


*Cong:* My Awesome One – God my Shepherd, my Creator, / the Rock who birthed me, my Creator and my Rock.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 57

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/57](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/57)

*Cong:* The King of Jacob is our Stronghold; / He is the Prescriber of our laws and our Savior.

*Leader:* The tower of salvation shall be my support and confidence; / the Lord God, is my strength.

*Cong:* Ruler of the world, Your kingdom / and reign are for all generations.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 61

*Leader:* O that You were my rother in times of distress; / save me, for Your hand lacks no strength.

*Leader:* The shield of my salvation, sword of pride; / our souls desire Your name and memory.

*Cong:* He is a shield for all who take shelter in Him; / happy is the man who takes strength in Him.

*Leader:* Clear, pleasant, enveloped in light, awesome; / His name is glorious and girded with might.

*Cong:* The Everlasting One of Israel and its Redeemer is faithful, / He never speaks falsehood; happy are those who await Him.

*Leader:* The Everlasting God of Yeshurun, the faithful God; / Judah has not been forsaken by its God.

*Cong:* He redeemed His beloved Abraham; / He shall redeem Israel His servant.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 79

*Leader:* The One feared by Isaac shall cast His fear / upon the foes of the children of His servant Jacob.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 80

*Cong:* My Creator seeks out and examines / all hearts; I shall show Him righteousness.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 81

*Leader:* He is like a parcel of myrrh, a cluster of henna; / He offers His nation redemption from sin.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 82

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/82](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/82)

*Cong:* The Beloved One is bright and ruddy; He is the Master of His hosts; / therefore He is called the Lord of hosts.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 83

*Leader:* The Lord is righteous, the perfect Rock; / I shall eternally trust the Rock of worlds.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 84

*Cong:* The hosts of heaven bow to Him; / Seraphim stand beside Him.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 85

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/85](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/85)

*Leader:* He is sanctified by a variety of holy declarations; / three bands of angels recite the threefold Kedusha.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 86

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/86](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/86)


*קהל:* קַיָּם לְעָלְמִין אֱלָהָא חַיָּא / מָרֵא דִי אַרְעָא וְדִי שְׁמַיָּא.


*Cong:* The living God exists forever; / the Master of the earth and the heavens.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 87

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/87](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/87)


*ש״ץ:* קוֹנִי מְרַחֵם, מְקַנֵּא לְשׂוֹנְאָיו / קֶֽרֶן יִשְׁעִי, קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו.


*Leader:* My Creator is merciful yet He is zealous toward His foes; / my Deliverer is close to those who call out to Him.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 88

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/88](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/88)


*קהל:* רָחוֹק מִכֹּל, וְאֶת כֹּל רוֹאֶה / כִּי רָם יהוה וְשָׁפָל יִרְאֶה.


*Cong:* He is distant from all, yet He sees all; / the Lord is lofty, yet He sees the lowly.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 89

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/89](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/89)


*ש״ץ:* רוֹעִי יהוה, לֹא אֶחְסַר כֹּל / וְרַב כֹּֽחַ וְרַב חֶֽסֶד לַכֹּל.


*Leader:* The Lord is my Shepherd, I shall not want; / He possesses great strength and does much kindness with all.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 90

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/90](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/90)


*קהל:* רַחוּם יהוה, רוֹפֵא וּמְחַבֵּשׁ / לִשְׁבוּרֵי לֵב, וְעָוֹן כּוֹבֵשׁ.


*Cong:* The Lord is merciful: He heals and binds up the wounds / of the brokenhearted and suppresses sin.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 91

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/91](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/91)


*ש״ץ:* רֵעִי כֻּלּוֹ הוּא מַחֲמַדִּים / מִשְׁפָּטָיו אֱמֶת, מְתוּקִים וַחֲמוּדִים.


*Leader:* My Friend is wholly desirable; / His laws are true, sweet and precious.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 92

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/92](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/92)


*קהל:* רִאשׁוֹן וְאַחֲרוֹן, מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד / עוֹלָם, אַתָּה אֵל שׁוֹכֵן עַד.


*Cong:* The first and the last from now until / eternity, You are God who abides forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 93

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/93](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/93)


*ש״ץ:* שַׁלִּיט, מֶֽלֶךְ שְׁמַיָּא, בְּכָל דָּר וְדָר / לֵהּ אֲנָא מְשַׁבַּח, מְרוֹמֵם וּמְהַדַּר.


*Leader:* The King of the heavens shall reign for all generations; / it is He that I praise, exalt and glorify.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 94

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/94](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/94)


*קהל:* שֶֽׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן יהוה אֱלֹהִים: / שׁוֹפֵט צֶֽדֶק וּמַשְׁפִּיל גְּבוֹהִים.


*Cong:* A Sun and a Shield is our Lord God; / a righteous Judge who lays the haughty low.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 95

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/95](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/95)


*ש״ץ:* שַׂגִּיא כֹֽחַ, לֹא מְצָאנֻֽהוּ / יַשְׂגִּיב בְּכֹחוֹ, וּמִי כָמֽוֹהוּ.


*Leader:* A Stronghold of strength – we cannot reveal Him; / He is exalted in His might – who is like Him?


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 96

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/96](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/96)


*קהל:* שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁמוֹ, כִּי שֶׁלּוֹ שָׁלוֹם / כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֶל חֲסִידָיו שָׁלוֹם.


*Cong:* His name is Solomon for peace (Shalom) is His alone; / He shall speak peace unto His devoted ones.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 97

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/97](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/97)

*Leader:* The name of the Lord is “I will be what I shall be”; / He is like the lofty horns of the wild ox to His people; He is like a lion.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 98

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/98](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/98)


*קהל:* שַׁדַּי מְאוֹרִי, מַלְכִּי וְאֵלִי / הַלְלוּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ נַפְשִׁי הַלְלִי.


*Cong:* The Almighty, my Light, my King and God; / Halleluya! My soul shall praise His name.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 99

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/99](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/99)


*ש״ץ:* תִּתַּמַּם עִם יוֹשְׁבֵי נְטָעִים / הַשָּׂרִיגִים שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת הָרוֹעִים.


*Leader:* You act uprightly with the righteous who dwell among Your plantations; / the tendrils are the three shepherds [our forefathers].


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 100

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/100](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/100)


*קהל:* תִּתְחַסַּד, תִּתָּבַר עִמָּם / וְעִם עִקְּשִׁים תִּתַּפַּל לְהֻמָּם.


*Cong:* You act kindly, purely, with their descendants; / while the twisted are dealt with tortuously until they are overwhelmed.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 101

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/101](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/101)


*ש״ץ:* תָּמִים דַּרְכְּךָ, תַּקִּיף מִכֹּל / תּוּכַל לְבַדְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כֹּל.


*Leader:* Your path is perfect, O mightiest One; / You alone are capable of doing everything.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 102

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/102](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/102)


*קהל:* תּוֹחַלְתִּי וְסִבְרִי וְתִקְוָתִי / תַּאֲוַת נַפְשִׁי וּתְשׁוּקָתִי.


*Cong:* You are my Expectation, my Promise, my Hope; / subject of my soul’s desire and longing.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 103

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/103](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/103)


*ש״ץ:* תְּהִלָּתִי וְתִפְאַרְתִּי וְעֻזִּי / מִמְּעֵי אִמִּי גּוֹחִי וְגוֹזִי.


*Leader:* My Praise, my Glory, my Strength; the One who my mother’s womb.
extracted me from


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Wednesday 104

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/104](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Wednesday/r/104)


*קהל:* תְּמִים דֵּעִים, אֵל דֵּעוֹת אֶחָד / כָּל הַלְּבָבוֹת דּוֹרֵשׁ יָֽחַד.


*Cong:* His knowledge is perfect; the knowing God is One; / He seeks out all hearts as one.

*Leader:* Who is like You, O Teacher of knowledge? / You create the speech of all lips.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/2)


*קהל:* מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ עָמְקוּ וְרָֽמוּ / וּשְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ לֹא יִתָּֽמּוּ:


*Cong:* Your thoughts are deep and lofty, / Your years of existence shall never end.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/3)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא לִמְּדֽוּךָ חָכְמָתֶֽךָ / וְלֹא הֱבִינֽוּךָ תְּבוּנָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* No one taught You Your wisdom, / and no one granted You Your insight.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/4)


*קהל:* לֹא קִבַּֽלְתָּ מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ / וְלֹא יָרַֽשְׁתָּ מֶמְשַׁלְתֶּֽךָ.


*Cong:* You did not receive Your reign from others, / and did not inherit Your dominion.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/5)


*ש״ץ:* לְעוֹלָם יְהִי לְךָ לְבַדֶּֽךָ / וְלֹא לַאֲחֵרִים, כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* Forever Yours alone / and never shared by others, shall be Your majestic glory.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/6)


*קהל:* וְלֹא תִתֵּן לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים / תְּהִלָּתְךָ, לַפְּסִילִים וְזָרִים.


*Cong:* And You will never grant to foreign gods / Your glory, nor to idols or strange deities.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/7)

*Leader:* All glory and honor is from You; / Your honor shall never belong to gods.
strange


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/8)


*קהל:* אַתָּה תָּעִיד בְּיִחוּדֶֽךָ / וְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ וַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* You shall testify to Your own , / and so shall Your Torah and Your servants.

###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 37

*ש״ץ:* כִּי שְׁמוֹתֶֽיךָ אֵלִים מְרוּצִים / בְּזָכְרְךָ לְחוּצִים, לְהַפְלִיא נְחוּצִים.


*Leader:* For in Your name the angels make haste, / to work wonders for Your oppressed people when You remember them.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/38)


*קהל:* וְאַשָּׁף וְחַרְטֹם לֹא יְלַחֲצֽוּךָ / וְכָל שֵׁם וְלַֽהַט לֹא יְנַצְּחֽוּךָ.


*Cong:* Enchanters and sorcerers do not press You; / no spell or enchantment can defeat You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/39)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא יְנַצְּחֽוּךָ כָּל הַחֲכָמִים / כָּל הַקּוֹסְמִים וְהַחַרְטֻמִּים.


*Leader:* Even all shrewd men could never defeat You, / nor magicians and sorcerers.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/40)


*קהל:* אַתָּה מֵשִׁיב לְאָחוֹר חֲכָמִים / לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְךָ עֲרוּמִים וְקוֹסְמִים.


*Cong:* You leave wise men dumbfounded; / crafty men and magicians could never overpower You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/41)


*ש״ץ:* לְהָשִׁיב לְאָחוֹר מְזִמּוֹתֶֽיךָ / לְהָפֵר עֲצַת סוֹד גְּזֵרָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* None could reverse Your plans / or void the counsel of Your concealed decrees.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/42)


*קהל:* מֵרְצוֹנְךָ לֹא יַעֲבִירֽוּךָ / לֹא יְמַהֲרֽוּךָ וְלֹא יְאַחֲרֽוּךָ.


*Cong:* You shall never be swayed from Your will; / none can cause You to hasten or delay it.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/43)


*ש״ץ:* עֲצָתְךָ תָּפֵר עֲצַת כָּל יוֹעֲצִים / וְעֻזְּךָ מַחֲלִישׁ לֵב אַמִּיצִים.


*Leader:* Your counsel shall void the counsel of all advisrs; / Your might weakens the hearts of brave men.
o


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/44)


*קהל:* אַתָּה מְצַוֶּה, וּפַחְדְּךָ מַשְׁוֶה / וְאֵין עָלֶֽיךָ פָּקִיד וּמְצַוֶּה.


*Cong:* You alone command all; Your dread straightens the paths of men; / no one gives You orders or commands You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/45)


*ש״ץ:* אַתָּה מִקְוֶה וְאֵינְךָ מְקַוֶּה / לְךָ כָּל מְקַוֶּה נֶֽפֶשׁ תִּרְוֶה.


*Leader:* You are the hope of all – but You do not hope; / You satiate all souls who await You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/46)


*קהל:* וְכָל הַיְצוּרִים וְכָל עִנְיָנָם / וְכָל יְקָר אֲשֶׁר בְּךָ, אֵין דִּמְיוֹנָם.


*Cong:* And all creatures and all that is theirs – / Your honor cannot be fathomed.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/47)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא מַחְשְׁבוֹתָם מַחְשְׁבוֹתֶֽיךָ / כִּי אֵין בּוֹרֵא זוּלָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* Your thoughts are not like their thoughts, / for there is no creator but You alone.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/48)


*קהל:* לְאֵין דִּמְיוֹן, נִפְלָא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ / לְאֵין חֵֽקֶר, נִשְׂגָּב אֲדוֹנֵֽנוּ.


*Cong:* Our God is extraordinary and cannot be compared; / no one can grasp our Master’s loftiness.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/49)


*ש״ץ:* סָתוּר מִכָּל סָתוּר, וְעָמוּס / מִכָּל עָמוּס, וּמִכָּל כָּמוּס.


*Leader:* He is the most hidden of all hidden, concealed / of all concealed, and of all enshrouded.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/50)


*קהל:* דַּק מִכָּל דַּק, וְצָפוּן מִכָּל / צָפוּן, וְיָכוֹל מִכָּל יָכוֹל.


*Cong:* More veiled than anything veiled; more deeply encrypted than anything encrypted; more powerful than any powerful being.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/51)


*ש״ץ:* נִשְׂגָּב מִכָּל נִשְׂגָּב, וְנֶעְלָם / מִכָּל נֶעְלָם, וּשְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם.


*Leader:* Exalted above all that is exalted; more mysterious / than any mysterious thing; His name is everlasting.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/52)


*קהל:* גָּבֽוֹהַּ מִכָּל גָּבֽוֹהַּ, וְעֶלְיוֹן / מִכָּל עֶלְיוֹן וּמִכָּל חֶבְיוֹן.


*Cong:* Higher than the highest being, loftier / than all lofty and all unknowable.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/53)


*ש״ץ:* חָבוּי וְעָמוּק מִכָּל עָמוּק / לֵב כָּל דַּֽעַת עָלָיו חָמוּק.


*Leader:* Concealed, deeper than the deepest; / His knowledge shall evade the heart of he who attempts to know Him.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 54

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/54](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/54)


*קהל:* שֶׁאֵין שֵֽׂכֶל וּמַדָּע וְחָכְמָה / יְכוֹלִים לְהַשְׁוֹת לוֹ כָּל מְאֽוּמָה.


*Cong:* For intellect, knowledge and wisdom / lack the power to attribute anything to Him.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 55

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/55](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/55)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא מַשִּׂיגִים לוֹ אֵיךְ וְכַמֶּה / לֹא מוֹצְאִים לוֹ דָּבָר דּוֹמֶה.


*Leader:* They are incapable of grasping His quality and quantity; / they cannot find any semblance of Him.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/56)


*קהל:* מִקְרֶה וְעַרְעַר וְשִׁנּוּי וְטָפֵל / וְחֶֽבֶר וּמִסְמַךְ, אוֹר וְגַם אֹֽפֶל.


*Cong:* Nor can they attribute to Him chance or temporality; change or subordinacy, / attachment to another or dependence, physical light or darkness.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 57

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/57](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/57)


*ש״ץ:* וְלֹא מוֹצְאִים לוֹ מַרְאֶה וְצֶֽבַע / וְלֹא כָל טֶֽבַע אֲשֶׁר שֵׁשׁ וָשֶֽׁבַע.


*Leader:* They cannot attach to Him an appearance or color; nor any natural thing that is six [like the movements] or seven [like the physical quantities].


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 58

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/58](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/58)


*קהל:* לָכֵן נְבוּכוֹת כָּל עֶשְׁתּוֹנוֹת / וְנִבְהָלוֹת כָּל הַחֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת.


*Cong:* Therefore, all human thought is confused, / all calculations disturbed.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 59

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/59](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/59)


*ש״ץ:* וְכָל שַׂרְעַפִּים וְכָל הַרְהוֹרִים / נִלְאִים לָשׂוּם בּוֹ שִׁעוּרִים.


*Leader:* All thoughts and reflections / are powerless to apply measurements to Him.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 60

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/60](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/60)


*קהל:* מִלְּשַׁעֲרֵֽהוּ וּמִלְּהַגְבִּילֵֽהוּ / מִלְּתָאֳרֵֽהוּ וּמִלְּפַרְסְמֵֽהוּ.


*Cong:* And cannot assess or apply limits to Him, / nor describe Him or expose Him.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 61

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/61](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/61)


*ש״ץ:* בְּכָל שִׂכְלֵֽנוּ חִפַּשְׂנֽוּהוּ / בְּמַדָּעֵֽנוּ, לִמְצוֹא מַה הוּא.


*Leader:* With all our intellect we have searched for Him, / trying with our knowledge to discover what He is.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 62

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/62](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/62)


*קהל:* לֹא מְצָאנֽוּהוּ וְלֹא יְדַעְנֽוּהוּ / אַךְ מִמַּעֲשָׂיו הִכַּרְנֽוּהוּ.


*Cong:* We have not discovered His nature nor have we become familiar with Him, / but we have recognized Him from His deeds.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 63

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/63](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/63)


*ש״ץ:* שֶׁהוּא לְבַדּוֹ יוֹצֵר אֶחָד / חַי וְכֹל יוּכַל וְחָכָם מְיֻחָד.


*Leader:* For He alone is the sole Creator, / a living, omnipotent Being, uniquely wise.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 64

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/64](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/64)


*קהל:* כִּי הוּא הָיָה לַכֹּל קֹֽדֶם / עַל כֵּן נִקְרָא אֱלֹהֵי קֶֽדֶם.


*Cong:* For He existed before all, / therefore He is called the ancient God.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 65

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/65](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/65)


*ש״ץ:* בַּעֲשׂוֹתוֹ בְּלִי כֹל אֶת הַכֹּל / יָדַֽעְנוּ כִּי הוּא כֹּל יָכוֹל.


*Leader:* He created all from nothingness; / we know that He is omnipotent.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 66

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/66](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/66)

*Cong:* All His works are performed with wisdom; / we know they are a result of insight.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 67

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/67](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/67)

*Leader:* When He renews creation each and every day, / we know that He is the God of the universe.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 68

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/68](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/68)


*קהל:* בַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה קֹֽדֶם לְכֻלָּם / יָדַֽעְנוּ כִּי הוּא חַי לְעוֹלָם.


*Cong:* Since He preceded all, / we know that He is everlasting.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 69

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/69](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/69)


*ש״ץ:* וְאֵין לְהַרְהֵר אַחַר יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ / בְּלִבֵּֽנוּ, וְלֹא בְּסִפּוּרֵֽנוּ.


*Leader:* must not have doubts about our Creator, / neither in our hearts nor in our words.
One


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 70

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/70](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/70)

*Cong:* We shall not attribute physicality to Him; / we shall not ascribe to Him subordinacy or form.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 71

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/71](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/71)

*Leader:* We shall not consider Him to be in a sitting or standing position, / nor a natural species or defined power or limited being.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 72

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/72](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/72)


*קהל:* כָּל הַנִּרְאִים וְהַנִּשְׂכָּלִים / וְהַמַּדָּעִים בְּעֶֽשֶׂר כְּלוּלִים.


*Cong:* He is not like any of the visible beings who were granted intellect / and knowledge in the ten statements of creation.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 73

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/73](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/73)


*ש״ץ:* וְשֶֽׁבַע כַּמָּיוֹת וְשֵֽׁשֶׁת נִדּוֹת / וְשָׁלֹשׁ גְּזֵרוֹת וְעִתּוֹת וּמִדּוֹת.


*Leader:* Nor can He be defined within the seven physical quantities or six movements, / nor the three decreed characteristics, nor the times or measurements.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 74

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/74](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/74)

*Cong:* For the Creator has none of these, / since He created them all as one.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 75

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/75](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/75)

*Leader:* All will shrivel and pass; / they shall perish and come to an end.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Shir HaYihud, Thursday 76

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/76](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Shir%20HaYihud,_Thursday/r/76)
