רַחֵץ טֶֽנֶף וְהָתֵם שִׁמְצָה / קַבֵּל אֶֽנֶק וּגְדֹר פִּרְצָה.


תָּמִים פָּעָלְךָ Your works are unblemished, O God of great counsel; / we have risen early to seek You out and observe Your righteousness.
Remove all filth and dissolve all accusations, / receive our groans and may our breached fences be repaired.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/35)


צֹאן לַטֶּֽבַח גָּזַר מִמִּכְלָה / פָּרִים וּכְבָשִׂים לִשְׁלָמִים וְעוֹלָה
עֲרִיכַת שָׂפָה נַעֲרֹךְ בִּתְפִלָּה / שִׂיחֵֽנוּ יָשְׁפַּר כְּהֶקְטֵר וּבְלוּלָה.


The flock we might have slaughtered to offer You has been destroyed – / young bulls and sheep which were once brought as peace- and burnt-offerings.
Now we set out our prayers before You instead; / may our speech be as pleasing to You as the incense and meal offerings.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/36)


נְתִיב יֹֽשֶׁר אִם נֶעֱקַל בְּלֶֽכֶת / מִשְׁלַחְתְּךָ לַעֲזֹב לְהִתְרַפּוֹת בִּמְלֶאכֶת
לְנֶגְדְּךָ יָפְקַד מִזְבַּח מַעֲרֶֽכֶת / כְּמַאֲכֶֽלֶת הַמַּאֲכִילָה מֵאָז נֶעֱרֶֽכֶת.


Should the straight path become crooked as we walk, / as we turn away from the Torah You sent us and become lazy in our worship,
may the altar upon which Isaac was arranged stand before You in remembrance / of the knife that was raised over him, and the meat we have been allowed to eat ever since.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/37)


יַֽחַד אָב וּבֵן בְּלֶכְתָּם לְהַר מוֹר / טֶֽבַח לְהָכִין, מִפְקָדְךָ לִשְׁמֹר
חֲנִיטָם נְצֹר רַחֲמִים לִכְמֹר / זֵֽכֶר שְׁבוּעָה כִּקְטֹֽרֶת לִתְמֹר.


Father and son walked toward Mount Moriah as one, / to obey Your command by preparing a sacrifice.
Guard their offspring and may Your compassion be awakened; / may the remembrance of Your oath be as pleasing as the upright column of incense.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/38)


וּבְשִׁבְתְּךָ הַיּוֹם לָדִין עַמִּים / הִמָּלֵא עַל צֶאֱצָאֵֽימוֹ רַחֲמִים
דִּינֵֽנוּ הַצְהֵר וְלֹא נֵצֵא נִכְלָמִים / גֶּֽפֶן מַטָּעָתְךָ תָּכִין לְאֹֽרֶךְ יָמִים.


And as You sit this day in judgment over nations, / may You look upon their offspring and be filled with compassion.
May You clear us in judgment and may we not come away ashamed; / may the vine You planted in Your land flourish forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/39)


בִּזְכוּת נֶעֱקָד הַקְשִֽׁיבָה מִשַּֽׁחַק / אֶבְיוֹנֵי עַמְּךָ, קוֹרְאֶֽיךָ מִדֹּֽחַק
שְׁמֵֽנוּ עַל סִפְרְךָ לְחַיִּים יֻחַק / וְנִיב שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ הַקְשֵׁב כְּוַיֶּעְתַּר יִצְחָק.


By virtue of the one who was bound on the altar may You listen from heaven / to those who call upon You out of hardship – the poor among Your nation.
Inscribe our names for life in Your book, / and heed the words on our lips as when Isaac entreated You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/41)


שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ מְדוֹבְבוֹת עֹז וּבְצִדְקָתוֹ נִחְיֶה / בְּרַחֲמִים יְצַדְּקֵֽנוּ וּזְרֹעֵֽנוּ יִהְיֶה
יְחַיֵּֽינוּ כְקֶֽדֶם מִיֹּמַֽיִם, אֶהְיֶה / בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יְקִימֵֽנוּ וְנִחְיֶה.


Our lips speak of Your strength and we shall live in Your righteousness; / vindicate us in Your compassion and be our arm of strength.
God shall heal us after these two days [of Rosh HaShana], as He did before; / He shall raise us up on the third day [Yom Kippur], and we will live.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/43)


מִי כָמֽוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים, זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים.
וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים.


מִי כָמֽוֹךָ Who is like You, compassionate Father,
who remembers His creatures in compassion, for life?
Faithful are You to revive the dead.
Blessed are You, LORD, who revives the dead.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/46)


שֻׁלַּֽחְתִּי בְּמַלְאֲכוּת סֶֽגֶל חֲבוּרָה / שׁוֹמְרֵי אֱמוּנָתְךָ וּמְיַחֲדֶֽיךָ בְמוֹרָא
שָׁפַֽכְתִּי שִֽׂיחַ לְבַקֵּשׁ עֲתִירָה / שְׁמַע־יהוה קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא:


שֻׁלַּֽחְתִּי I have been sent as emissary by Your chosen congregation, / those who guard Your faith and recognize Your Oneness in awe.
I have poured out my heart to be granted entreaty: / Lord, hear my voice when I cry out.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/48)


מְדַבֵּר בִּצְדָקָה, חוֹנֵן וּמִתְרַצֶּה / מַחֲסֶה וּמִסְתּוֹר לְדוֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ הִמָּצֵא
מֶֽתַח דִּינְךָ אִם בִּיצוּרִים תְּמַצֶּה / מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִי יֵצֵא:


You who speak righteousness, who grants favor and is willingly appeased, / let refuge and sanctuary be found by those who seek You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/49)


עֵֽרֶךְ תְּקִיעָתֵֽנוּ שְׁעֵה בְּבֵירוּרִים / עַרְבֵּב קַטֵּגוֹר וְאַמֵּץ סַנֵּגוֹרִים
עֲקֶֽרֶת בַּֽיִת וַחֲצוּבַת צוּרִים / עֵינֶֽיךָ תֶּחֱזֶינָה מֵישָׁרִים:


Accept the order of our shofar blasts without any reservations, / confuse our accusers and strengthen our defenders.
For Israel, Your matron, the congregation hewn from stone, / Your eyes behold all deeds justly.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/50)


וְיִזָּכֵר לְפָנֶֽיךָ צִדְקַת הַתָּם / וִעֵד אֹהָלֶֽיךָ וּבְכִסְאֲךָ נֶחְתָּם
וְחַלְּצֵֽנִי מִפֶּֽשַׁע, וּמֵעָוֹן נִכְתָּם / אַל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִי אָז אֵיתָם:


May the righteousness of the innocent Jacob be remembered before You, / he who dwelled in Your tents and whose image is engraved on Your throne.
Rescue me from evil and the blemish of iniquity; / I shall be innocent if they do not dominate me.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/51)


נוֹהֵג בְּחֶֽסֶד, זוֹכֵר הַבְּרִית / נַקֵּֽנוּ מִנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְנִזְכֶּה כְּבֹרִית
נְחֵֽנוּ בַּאֲמִתְּךָ, וּתְנֵֽנוּ לְאַחֲרִית / נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וְעֹבֵר עַל־פֶּֽשַׁע לִשְׁאֵרִית:


O You who act kindly and remember the covenant, / cleanse us as with soap, that we may be pure of any hidden sins.
Guide us in Your truth and ensure that we prevail, / You who bear the iniquity and evil of the remnants of Your nation.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/52)


בְּהִנַּשְׂאֲךָ לְכִסֵּא, נוֹרָא וְאָיֹם / בְּרוּאֵי חֶֽלֶד לְהִשָּׁפֵט כְּהַיּוֹם
בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ עָלֵֽינוּ הַמְצִיאֵֽנוּ פִדְיוֹם / בֵּאלֹהִים הִלַּלְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם:


As You ascend to Your awesome, dreadful throne, / to judge the creatures of the earth this day,
in Your compassion toward us grant us redemption, / for we have praised God this entire day.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/53)


רֹֽעַ יִצְרֵֽנוּ הָסֵר בְּחֶמְלָתֶֽךָ / רְצֵֽנוּ וְסוֹכְכֵֽנוּ בְּמַֽחַס אֶבְרָתֶֽךָ
רְצֵה תְשׁוּבָתֵֽנוּ וְהַרְבֵּה מְחִילָתֶֽךָ / רְעֵה עַמְּךָ בְשִׁבְטֶֽךָ, צֹאן נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ:


In Your compassion remove our evil inclinations, / desire us and shield us in the shelter of Your wings.
Crave our repentance and may Your forgiveness be abundant, / tend Your people with Your staff – the flock of Your heritage.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 54

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/54](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/54)


יַדְּעֵֽנוּ דְרָכֶֽיךָ וְאָרְחוֹתֶֽיךָ לִתְמֹד / יֹֽשֶׁר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ בְּלִבֵּֽנוּ לִצְמֹד
יִכָּמְרוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ סְלִיחָתֵֽנוּ לַחְמֹד / יָדַֽעְנוּ כִּי חָטָֽאנוּ, וְאֵין מִי יַעֲמֹד.


Teach us to forever walk in Your ways, / that the uprightness of Your commandments might be bound to our hearts.
May Your compassion be stirred to covet our forgiveness; / we know that we have sinned and there is no one who can withstand Your judgment.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 55

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/55](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/55)


צַוֵּה יְשׁוּעָתְךָ לְרַעְיָתְךָ הָאֲהוּבָה / צְמֵאָה לְחַסְדְּךָ, כְּמֵהָה וּתְאֵבָה
צְפֵה וְהַבֵּט כִּי מְאֹד נִכְאָֽבָה / צִדְקָתְךָ כְּהַרְרֵי־אֵל, מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ תְּהוֹם רַבָּה:


Command salvation for Your beloved bride, Israel, / who thirsts for Your kindness and faints in longing for You.
Look and behold how she is in great pain; / Your righteousness is like the great mountains and Your judgments permeate the vast depths.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/56)


חֲפֹץ בְּהֶגְיוֹנֵֽנוּ וּבְקוֹל תְּרוּעָתֵֽנוּ / חֲטָאֵֽינוּ הַלְבֵּן וְהַפְקֵר שִׁגְגֵֽנוּ
חַבֵּל וְהַצְמֵת קָדְקֹד מַשְׂטִינֵֽנוּ / חָנֵּֽנוּ אֱלֹהִים חָנֵּֽנוּ, כִּי בְךָ חָסָֽיָה נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ.


Desire our utterances and the sound of our shofar blasts, / cleanse us of our sins and cast away all our mistakes.
Utterly destroy the heads of our accusers. / Be gracious to us, O God, be gracious, for our souls take refuge in You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 57

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/57](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/57)


קָרְבֵֽנוּ לְיִשְׁעֲךָ בְּזֶה רֹאשׁ שְׁנָתִי / קַבֵּץ נְפֻצוֹתֵֽינוּ לְמִרְבַּץ קִרְיָתִי
קָמִים יֶחֱזוּ כִּי מֵאִתְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי / קַוֹּה קִוִּֽיתִי יהוה תּוֹחַלְתִּי.


Bring us closer to Your salvation on this day of our New Year; / gather all our exiles that they may dwell in our holy city.
May those who rise against me see that my salvation lies in You, / for I turn my hopes toward the Lord; He is the subject of all my hopes.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 59

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/59](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/59)


יִמְלֹךְ יהוה לְעוֹלָם
אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר
הַלְלוּיָהּ:


The LORD shall reign for ever.
He is your God, Zion,
from generation to generation,
Halleluya!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 60

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/60](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/60)


וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ, יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל:


You are the Holy One,
enthroned on the praises of Israel.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 63

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/63](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/63)

God, please.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 64

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/64](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/64)


אַתָּה הוּא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ.
גִּבּוֹר וְנַעֲרָץ דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָה.
הוּא שָׂח וַיֶּֽהִי וְצִוָּה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ.
זִכְרוֹ לָנֶֽצַח חַי עוֹלָמִים.
טְהוֹר עֵינַֽיִם יוֹשֵׁב סֵֽתֶר.
כִּתְרוֹ יְשׁוּעָה לְבוּשׁוֹ צְדָקָה.
מַעֲטֵֽהוּ קִנְאָה נֶאְפָּד נְקָמָה.
סִתְרוֹ יֹֽשֶׁר עֲצָתוֹ אֱמוּנָה.
פְּעֻלָּתוֹ אֱמֶת צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר.
קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו בֶּאֱמֶת רָם וּמִתְנַשֵּׂא.
שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים תּוֹלֶה אֶֽרֶץ עַל בְּלִימָה.


You are our God, in heaven and on earth.
Mighty and revered, encircled with myriads.
He spoke and it was, commanded and it came
into being.
His memory is forever, His life is everlasting.
Pure of eye, He sits concealed.
His crown is salvation, His garment is righteousness.
His cloak is jealousy, His coat is vengeance.
His counsel is candor, His wisdom is faith.
His deeds are truth, He is righteous and upright.
He is close to those who
call upon Him in truth, He is sublime and lofty.
He resides in the heavens, and hangs the earth over
emptiness.

He is alive and everlasting, awesome, lofty and holy.

שְׁמוֹ מְפָאֲרִים עֲדַת חֶבְלוֹ
וְנַעֲרָץ בְּאֶרְאֶלֵּי קֹֽדֶשׁ הִלּוּלוֹ
וּבְהֵיכָלוֹ כָּבוֹד אֹמֵר כֻּלּוֹ / קָדוֹשׁ.


שְׁמוֹ His name is glorified by His rightful congregation,
and revered in songs of praise by the angels.
And in His Sanctuary His glory is spoken of by everyone. / O Holy One.

שׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְוֹתָיו עוֹד יְשׁוּבוּן לְבִצָּרוֹן
נִדְבָּרִים יְרֵאָיו בְּהַכְשֵׁר וְיִתָּרוֹן
וַיַּקְשֵׁב יהוה וַיִּשְׁמָע, וַיִּכָּתֵב סֵֽפֶר זִכָּרוֹן: / קָדוֹשׁ.


The keepers of His commandments will yet return to their fortified haven;
His faithful followers converse with one another with much skill and wisdom:
And the Lord hearkened and listened and a book of remembrance was written. / O Holy One.

שַׁפְּרוּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם, וּבְרִית לֹא תוּפַר
נַאֲקַתְכֶם יַאֲזִין, שְׁחָקִים שִׁפַּר
וְתִיטַב לַיהוה מִשּׁוֹר פָּר: / קָדוֹשׁ.


Refine your deeds so that the covenant may endure.
He who adorns the heavens shall heed your groans,
and your prayers shall be more pleasing to the Lord than an ox or bullock. / O Holy One.

שִׁבְטֵי מְקֹרָאֲךָ עַלֵּה וְהַמְשֵׁל
נְטִישׁוֹת צָרִים בַּהֲתִזְּךָ לְנַשֵּׁל
כִּי לַיהוה הַמְּלוּכָה, וּמֹשֵׁל: / קָדוֹשׁ.


Raise up the tribes that call upon You and let them rule,
as the outstretched branches of their oppressors are cut down and removed,
for the kingdom belongs to the Lord and He rules. / O Holy One.

שְׁבוּתֵֽנוּ מִמֶּרְחָק, עֲלוֹת לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ
וּנְפָאֲרֶנּוּ תָמִיד בִּדְבִיר מִקְדָּשׁוֹ
כִּי־זָכַר אֶת־דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ: / קָדוֹשׁ.


May He return our captives from afar to His holy mount,
that we might glorify Him always in His holy Sanctuary,
for He has remembered His holy vow. / O Holy One.

שֶֽׁבַח מִגְדַּל עֹז, שֵׁם הַגָּדוֹל
נֶֽצַח בְּתִתּוֹ לְמַלְכּוֹ עֹז וּמִגְדּוֹל
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל: / קָדוֹשׁ.


His great name is praised as a tower of strength;
He shall eternally give His Messianic king strength and greatness.
On that day, a great shofar shall be sounded. O Holy One.

*קהל:* זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא־קֹֽדֶשׁ:


*Leader:* He taught [Isaac’s] offshoots to sound the shofar at the start of this month, / and if the holy Sabbath should happen to fall upon this day,
*Cong:* Then the remembrance of the sound of the shofar shall serve to sanctify it.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 89

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/89](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/89)


*ש״ץ:* טִבְעוֹ אִם בְּחוֹל יְבוֹאֲכֶם / צַוּוּ לִתְקֹֽעַ בְּכָל גְּבוּלְכֶם
*קהל:* יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם:


*Leader:* Yet should its arrival for a scheduled weekday be announced, / then the command should go out that in all your borders the shofar shall sound,
*Cong:* For it shall be a day for you on which the shofar shall resound.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 90

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/90](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/90)


שַׁפְּרוּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם, וּבְרִית לֹא תוּפַר / נַאֲקַתְכֶם יַאֲזִין, שְׁחָקִים שִׁפַּר
וְתִיטַב לַיהוה מִשּׁוֹר פָּר: / קָדוֹשׁ.


Refine your deeds so that the covenant may endure. / He who adorns the heavens shall heed your groans,
and your prayers shall be more pleasing to the Lord than an ox or bullock. / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 91

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/91](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/91)


*ש״ץ:* יָרוּם צוּר יִשְׁעִי בְּפִי כָּל אֻמִּים / חֲשֹׂף זְרוֹעֲךָ לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ מִמִּתְקוֹמְמִים
*קהל:* מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים:


*Leader:* May the Rock of my salvation be exalted in the mouth of every nation. / Reveal Your mighty arm to save Your people from those who rise against them.
*Cong:* For Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 92

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/92](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/92)


*ש״ץ:* כְּהִגָּלוֹתְךָ לְעֵין כֹּל שִׁכְנְךָ לְהִוָּעֵד / קְהִלּוֹת וּרְבָבוֹת בְּפִֽימוֹ לְהָעֵד
*קהל:* יהוה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:


*Leader:* When You will reveal Yourself to the eyes of all and appear within Your Sanctuary, / congregations and multitudes will come forth to bear testimony:
*Cong:* The Lord shall reign forever and ever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 93

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/93](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/93)


*ש״ץ:* לְךָ יָאֲתָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז הֲגוּיִים / חֶֽלֶד וְשׁוֹכְנֶֽיהָ וְכָל הָאִיִּים
*קהל:* מִי לֹא יִרָאֲךָ מֶֽלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם:


*Leader:* Strength and honor are fitting for You, uttered by / all the world, its inhabitants and all the islands.
*Cong:* Who shall not fear You, O King of all nations?


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 94

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/94](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/94)


שִׁבְטֵי מְקֹרָאֲךָ עַלֵּה וְהַמְשֵׁל / נְטִישׁוֹת צָרִים בַּהֲתִזְּךָ לְנַשֵּׁל
כִּי לַיהוה הַמְּלוּכָה, וּמֹשֵׁל: / קָדוֹשׁ.


Raise up the tribes that call upon You and let them rule, / as the outstretched branches of their oppressors are cut down and removed,
for the kingdom belongs to the Lord and He rules. / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 95

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/95](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/95)


*ש״ץ:* מוֹטֹת צָרִים שַׁבֵּר וְהַכְחִידֵם / זְרוּיֶֽיךָ קַבֵּץ וְחִנָּם תִּפְדֵּם
*קהל:* זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִֽיתָ קֶּֽדֶם:


*Leader:* Shatter and destroy the beams placed upon us by our oppressors, / gather Your scattered exiles and freely offer them redemption.
*Cong:* Remember the congregation You acquired long ago.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 96

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/96](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/96)


*ש״ץ:* נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים יְנֻחֲמוּ בְּכִפְלַֽיִם / קָמֵיהֶם עַל פָּנֵֽימוֹ גַּלֵּה שׁוּלָֽיִם
*קהל:* זְכֹר יהוה לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם:


*Leader:* The noblest of nations shall be comforted doubly; / those who rise against them shall be exposed in humiliation.
*Cong:* May the Lord recall the day of Jerusalem’s defeat and visit retribution upon the descendants of Edom.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 97

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/97](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/97)


*ש״ץ:* סִלּוּל מְסִלָּתֵֽנוּ יַשֵּׁר לִצְעֹד / וּבֵן יַקִּירְךָ קַרְסֹל לֹא יִמְעֹד
*קהל:* כְּנַֽמְתָּ, זָכֹר אֶזְכְּרֶֽנּוּ עוֹד:


*Leader:* Pave a straight road for us that we might stride, / and do not allow the ankles of Your precious child to falter.
*Cong:* As You have spoken: “I will remember him always.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 98

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/98](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/98)


שְׁבוּתֵֽנוּ מִמֶּרְחָק, עֲלוֹת לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ / וּנְפָאֲרֶנּוּ תָמִיד בִּדְבִיר מִקְדָּשׁוֹ
כִּי־זָכַר אֶת־דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ: / קָדוֹשׁ.


May He return our captives from afar to His holy mount, / that we might glorify Him always in His holy Sanctuary,
for He has remembered His holy vow. / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 99

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/99](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/99)


*ש״ץ:* קִרְיַת מָשׂוֹשׂ, הֵיכָל וְאוּלָם / מִזְבֵּֽחַ יָשִׁיב, וּכְלֵי שָׁרֵת כֻּלָּם
*קהל:* יהוה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם:


*Leader:* May there be joy in the city, in the Sanctuary and hall. / May He restore the altar and all the attendant vessels.
*Cong:* The Lord shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 100

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/100](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/100)


*ש״ץ:* שָׁמַֽיִם וָאָֽרֶץ יְרַנְּנוּ לִשְׁמוֹ / יְעָרוֹת יִמְחֲאוּ כַף לְהַנְעִימוֹ
*קהל:* כִּי־פָקַד יהוה אֶת־עַמּוֹ:


*Leader:* The heavens and earth shall sing in His honor. / The forests shall clap hands to offer pleasant sounds to Him,
*Cong:* For the Lord has finally appointed His people.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 101

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/101](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/101)


*ש״ץ:* תֹּֽקֶף אֶרְאֶלִּים וְכוֹכְבֵי צְפָר / תְּהִלּוֹת יְתַנּוּ שֶֽׁבַח לְהַשְׁפַּר
*קהל:* הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּתֵֽקַע שׁוֹפָר:


*Leader:* The splendor of angels and the morning stars / shall offer praise and pleasant song.
*Cong:* Praise Him with the sounding of the shofar.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 103

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/103](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/103)


יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶֽדֶק, וּלְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים / הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ.


יִשְׁפֹּט He judges the world with righteousness
and all nations with equity. / O Holy God.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 104

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/104](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/104)


וְהוּא בְאֶחָד וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ, וְנַפְשׁוֹ אִוְּתָה וַיָּֽעַשׂ: / נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ.


וְהוּא For He alone is Lord – who can refuse Him?
What His soul desires, He performs. / O Awesome and Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 106

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/106](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/106)


אֶתֵּן לְפֹעֲלִי צֶֽדֶק / בַּיּוֹם הַנִּבְחָר מַֽעַשׂ לְהִבָּדֵק.
גַּאֲוָתוֹ מְאֹד גָּדְלָה / דֶּֽרֶךְ עַנְוָתוֹ לְפִי הַגְּדֻלָּה.
הוּא אֲדוֹן הָעוֹלָם / וּמִי־הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו, וַיִּשְׁלָם:
זוֹכֵר הוֹלֵךְ בַּתֹּם / חוֹנֵן וְעֹשֵׂה דִּין יָתוֹם.
טָהוֹר מָרוֹם וְנִשָּׂא / יָפֶה בְעִתּוֹ הַכֹּל עָשָׂה.
כַּבִּיר לֹא יִמְאַס / לְנִבְזֶה בְעֵינָיו, נִמְאָס.
מְפֹאָר רֹכֵב עֲרָבוֹת / נֹֽגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ, וְאֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת.
סוֹעֵף בַּחֲרָבוֹת שְׁנוּנוֹת / עֲבוּר יְתוֹמִים וְאַלְמָנוֹת.
פֹּֽעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֵּם / צָר פֶּה וּמֵשִׂים אִלֵּם.
קֹנֵה הַכֹּל בְּרַחֲמִים / רָם וּמַשְׁפִּיל רָמִים.
שׁוֹפֵט יְצוּרָיו בַּחֲנִינָה / תְּמִים פֹּֽעַל, אֵל אֱמוּנָה.
שֹֽׁפְטֵי אֶֽרֶץ כַּתֹּֽהוּ / מִפַּחְדּוֹ יִבָּהֲלוּ וְיִתְמָֽהוּ.
עוֹשֵׂה מִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ / וּתְחִלָּה מְקַדְּמָם מִפְּנֵי זַעְמוֹ.
נְדִיבִים בְּדִקְדּוּקָם יָחִֽילוּ / בַּאֲשֶׁר מִשְׁפָּטוֹ פָּעָֽלוּ.
רוֹאֶה כָּל תַּעֲלוּמוֹת / יוֹשֵׁב בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמוֹת.
צוֹפֶה כָּל נוֹלָדוֹת / חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל הָעֲתִידוֹת.
קֹרֵא הַדֹּרוֹת מֵרֹאשׁ / חִקְרֵי לֵב לָתוּר וְלִדְרֹשׁ.
זוֹכֵר בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים / קַיֵּם שְׁבוּעָה לָאַחֲרוֹנִים.


אֶתֵּן I shall ascribe righteousness to my Maker / on the day chosen for all deeds to be examined.
His majesty has greatly flourished, / but His humility is equal to His grandeur.
He is Master of the world entire; / who ever hardened his heart against Him and remained whole?
He recalls those who walk innocently, / He has compassion and takes up the orphan’s cause.
He is pure, lofty and sublime, / He made all things becomingly at the proper time.
The Mighty One does not despise / anyone who is lowly in his own eyes.
Glorious, He rides the heavens, / fiery flames and bright light shine before Him.
He cuts down the evil with sharpened swords / on behalf of the orphans and the widows.
He offers man recompense for all his deeds, / He creates mouths to speak and renders speakers dumb.
He created all with compassion, / He is lofty, and lays lofty ones low.
He pardons His creatures with grace, / the works of the true God are perfect.
The earthly judges are vacant in His presence, / astounded and affrighted in their awe of Him.
He takes up the cause of His nation, / judging them first to spare them His wrath.
The righteous tremble under His close scrutiny, / though they performed His laws faithfully.
He sees all hidden things, / residing in the lofty heavens.
He foresees events before they occur / and hastens the occurrences of the future.
He proclaims the future of all generations before they come to pass, / searching and examining the inner workings of hearts.
He who remembers His covenant with our ancestors, / may He fulfill His oath toward their descendants.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 110

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/110](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/110)


תָּעִיר וְתָרִֽיעַ, לְהַכְרִית כָּל מֵרִֽיעַ
וְתֻקְדַּשׁ בְּיוֹדְעֵי לְהָרִֽיעַ. קָדוֹשׁ.


תָּעִיר Awaken and sound the shofar, cut down all evildoers,
and be sanctified by those who know to observe
the sounding of the shofar. O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 112

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/112](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/112)


אַדֶּֽרֶת מַמְלָכָה / עַל מָה הֻשְׁלָֽכָה / וְעוֹד לֹא מָלְכָה
לַבֵּל הִמְלִֽיכָה / וְאַחֲרָיו הָלְכָה / שֶׁלֹּא כַּהֲלָכָה
עָלֶֽיהָ הֻמְלְכָה / גְּבֶֽרֶת מַמְלָכָה / עַד תּוֹפִֽיעַ מְלוּכָה.


אַדֶּֽרֶת The glorious mantle of our royalty – / why was it torn from us? / And we have not returned to rule since / the Babylonian idol Bel was crowned king. / All followed it, so willing, / in contrast to the laws of our religion. / A foreign power has reigned in mastery / over all of our people who will not be free / until the kingdom of the Lord shall appear.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 113

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/113](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/113)


זְבוּלִי חָרְכָה / מַתְמִימַי פָּרְכָה / וְנִתַּן לָהּ אַרְכָה
רָחֲבָה וְאָרְכָה / וְקֶֽשֶׁת דָּרְכָה / וְעֹל הֶאֱרִֽיכָה
בִּעֲתָה בְּרַכָּה / וְהִנֵּה דְרוּכָה / וְעַד עַתָּה מוֹלְכָה.


They burned my Temple, / they broke the backs of my innocent ones in slavery / and they have been given allowance to do as they please. / They spread throughout the length and breadth of the land / and drew back their bows, / extending the yoke of their oppression, / frightening the soft nation of Israel, / which now lies there trampled / while still the foreigners rule.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 114

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/114](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/114)


יְסוֹדוֹת עֲרֵמָה / עֵרָה וְהֶחֱרִֽימָה / וְעַד יְסוֹד עָרְמָה
רֹאשׁ הֵרִֽימָה / וְסוֹד הֶעֱרִֽימָה / וְיָדָהּ רָֽמָה
בָּעֲרָה מֵעָרְמָה / וְעַד שַֽׁחַק רוּמָה / וְתֶאְפֹּד מְלוּכָה.


The foundations of the Sanctuary, which sustained the heaps of tithes, / were stripped and confiscated by the enemy horde, / and the Temple was laid bare to its foundation. / They raised their haughty heads in evil / and took crafty counsel against Your people; / they wielded the upper hand. / They burned with evil intentions; / their arrogance extended as far as the heavens / while they girded themselves with Your royal vestments.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 115

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/115](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/115)


יְרִיעוֹתַי גִּדְּדָה / אָהֳלִי שִׁדְּדָה / וְחָרְשָׁה וְשִׂדְּדָה
קְצִינוּת רָפְדָה / וּמַלְכוּת אָפְדָה / וְזֹאת הִקְפִּֽידָה
יָזְמָה וּמָרְדָה / עֲבוֹד לַזָּר חָרְדָה / וְחִלְּלָה מְלוּכָה.


They shred my curtains clear away / and plundered my Sanctuary, / turning over the earth till it was plowed clear. / They spread their rule / and adopted royal garb, / angering Your nation. / They plotted and conspired to rebel against God, / and labored to sway Your people to worship strange gods / as they defiled the reign of our Lord.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 116

לָחֲצָה בְּנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ / וּפָֽצָה לְעֵין מֶֽלֶךְ / מִי לִי בְּדוֹק מֶֽלֶךְ
יָהֲרָה בְּכֵס מֶֽלֶךְ / זוּלָתִי אֵין מֶֽלֶךְ / אֲנִי וְאַפְסִי מֶֽלֶךְ
רָם עַל כָּל מֶֽלֶךְ / תַּגְעִילֶֽנָּה מִמֶּֽלֶךְ / וּלְךָ תָּשִׁיב מְלוּכָה.


They oppressed the children of the King, / and before His eyes they uttered the words: / “What king do we have in heaven?” / They spoke arrogantly of the King’s throne, / saying, “There is no other king but me; / no other king but I alone.” / O You who are loftier than any earthly king, / remove them and they shall no longer rule, / and reclaim the reign for Yourself alone.

תָּעִיר וְתָרִֽיעַ, לְהַכְרִית כָּל מֵרִֽיעַ, וְתֻקְדַּשׁ בְּיוֹדְעֵי לְהָרִֽיעַ. קָדוֹשׁ.


תָּעִיר Awaken and sound the shofar, cut down all evildoers, and be sanctified by those who know to observe the sounding of the shofar. O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 120

מֶֽלֶךְ מְמַלֵּט מֵרָעָה
לְיוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה.
הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ.


מֶֽלֶךְ O King who offers deliverance from evil,
to those who observe the sounding of the shofar.
O Holy God.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 122

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/122](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/122)


מֶֽלֶךְ זְכוֹר אֲחוּז קֶֽרֶן
לְתוֹקְעֵי לְךָ הַיּוֹם בְּקֶֽרֶן.
נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ.


מֶֽלֶךְ O King, recall the ram caught by its horns in the thicket,
on behalf of those who sound the ram’s horn on this day.
O Awesome and Holy One.

אַאְפִּיד נֵֽזֶר אָיוֹם / בְּשִׁלּוּשׁ קְדֻשָּׁה בַּיּוֹם.
גִּבּוֹרֵי כֹֽחַ גְּדֻלָּה / דַּהֲרֽוּהוּ בְּבֵית דְּגִילָה.


אַאְפִּיד I shall crown the Awesome One / by proclaiming His holiness threefold in the Kedusha on this day.
Mighty angelic heroes of strength and greatness, / gallop forward to receive Him in the house where His banner is raised!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 125

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/125](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/125)


הוֹגֵי הֶֽגֶה הֲמֻלָּה / וַתְּקֽוּהוּ בְּהַלֵּל וּמִלָּה.
זוֹכֵר לָעַד זְכֻיּוֹת / חַדְּשֽׁוּהוּ זֶֽמֶר חַיּוֹת.


The angelic camp that raises its voice in rousing sound, / exalts Him with fine words of praise!
For the One who forever recalls the merits of His creatures, / sing a new song of angelic praise!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 126

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/126](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/126)


טוֹב עוֹמֵס טֹֽרַח / יַחֲדֽוּהוּ בְּחִדּוּשׁ יָֽרַח.
כּוֹבֵשׁ כָּל כְּעָסִים / לְבַל אַף לְהָשִׂים.


The Good One bears our burdens for us; / declare His unity as the new moon comes!
He suppresses all sentiments of anger / so as not to implement the issue of His ire.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 127

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/127](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/127)


מְשָׁרְתֵי בְּחִיל מוֹרָא / נָכְחָם הַלְלוּ נוֹרָא.
שַׂרְפֵי סְבִיב סְעָרָה / עֱנוּ לְמַעֲבִיר עֶבְרָה.


The angelic servants in His retinue of awe / offer awesome words of praise in the presence of Israel!
Seraphim, who swirl in the stormy ether: / call out to the One who removes His anger!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 128

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/128](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/128)


פְּלִיאִים פִּצְחוּ פֶה / צַלְצְלוּ הַכֹּל צוֹפֶה.
קְהִלּוֹת עַם קְדוֹשִׁים / רוֹמְמֽוּהוּ רִבְבוֹת רוֹעֲשִׁים.


Wondrous angels, open your mouths to sing / in praise of the One who sees all things!
Congregations of this holy nation: / noisily clamor in your multitudes to elevate Him!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 129

שֵֽׁמַע קוֹל שׁוֹפָר / תַּאֲזִין, וְאַשְׁמָה תוּפָר.
תְּשַׁלֵּשׁ שׁוֹפָרוֹת בְּהַר הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ / וַאֲשַׁלֵּשׁ קְדֻשָּׁה בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ.


Please, sound the shofar thrice on Your holy mount, / and I shall now proclaim Your threefold holiness in full sanctity.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 130

מֶֽלֶךְ זְכוֹר אֲחוּז קֶֽרֶן, לְתוֹקְעֵי לְךָ הַיּוֹם בְּקֶֽרֶן. נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ.


O King recall the ram caught by its horns in the thicket, on behalf of those who sound the ram’s horn on this day. O Awesome and Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 132

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/132](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/132)


שֶֽׁבַח מִגְדַּל עֹז, שֵׁם הַגָּדוֹל
נֶֽצַח בְּתִתּוֹ לְמַלְכּוֹ עֹז וּמִגְדּוֹל
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל: קָדוֹשׁ.


שֶֽׁבַח His great name is praised as a tower of strength;
He shall eternally give His Messianic king strength and greatness.
On that day, a great shofar shall be sounded. O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 134

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/134](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/134)


*ש״ץ:* עֲמוּסֶֽיךָ תּוֹקְעִים וּמְרִיעִים בַּשּׁוֹפָר / אִמְרָתְךָ לְקַיֵּם כַּחֹק הַמְסֻפָּר
*קהל:* תִּקְעוּ בַחֹֽדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר:


*Leader:* The nation You have borne shall blast and sound the shofar, adhering to Your command according to the prescribed ritual.
*Cong:* Sound the shofar at the New Moon.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 135

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/135](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/135)


*ש״ץ:* פִּשְׁעָם הַעֲבֵר וַעֲוֹנָם יְכֻפַּר / מַעֲנָם יֶעֱרַב כְּהַקְרָבַת כְּבָשִׂים וָפָר
*קהל:* בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר:


*Leader:* Please remove their sins that their iniquity might be forgiven.
May their prayer be as delightful to You as an offering of sheep or young bull.
*Cong:* Among trumpets and the sound of the shofar.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 136

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/136](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/136)


*ש״ץ:* צִמְחֵיהֶם יִרְבּוּ כַּחוֹל אֵין מִסְפָּר / צְבֻרֵיהֶם יְעוֹרְרוּ וְיַעֲלוּ מֵעָפָר
*קהל:* כִּנְשֹׂא־נֵס הָרִים תִּרְאוּ, וְכִתְקֹֽעַ שׁוֹפָר:


*Leader:* May their offshoots multiply like the immeasurable sand,
and their buried ones awaken and rise from the dust.
*Cong:* You shall witness it like a raised banner on a mountain and like the sound of a shofar.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 137

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/137](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/137)


שֶֽׁבַח מִגְדַּל עֹז, שֵׁם הַגָּדוֹל / נֶֽצַח בְּתִתּוֹ לְמַלְכּוֹ עֹז וּמִגְדּוֹל
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל: קָדוֹשׁ.


His great name is praised as a tower of strength;
He shall eternally give His Messianic king strength and greatness.
On that day, a great shofar shall be sounded. O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 140

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/140](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/140)


אָדוֹן, אִם מַעֲשִׂים אֵין בָּֽנוּ
שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יַעֲמָד לָֽנוּ
וְאַל תָּבוֹא בְמִשְׁפָּט עִמָּֽנוּ / קָדוֹשׁ.


אָדוֹן Master, if we are devoid of good deeds,
let Your great name still remain with us.
Do not approach to judge us. / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 142

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/142](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/142)


הֵן לֹא יַאֲמִין בִּקְדֹשָׁיו
וְתָהֳלָה יָשִׂים בְּאֵלֵי תַרְשִׁישָׁיו
וְאֵיךְ יִצְדְּקוּ קְרוּצֵי גוּשָׁיו / קָדוֹשׁ.


הֵן For He believes not even in His holy beings,
and casts aspersions on His angels of aquamarine.
And how then will those who were but culled
from clods of earth be vindicated? / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 145

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/145](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/145)


וּבְכֵן, וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶֽלֶךְ:


וּבְכֵן And so – [The LORD] became King in Yeshurun.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 146

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/146](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/146)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
אַמִּיץ הַמְנֻשֵּׂא / לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ מִתְנַשֵּׂא
אוֹמֵר וְעוֹשֶׂה / מָעוֹז וּמַחְסֶה
נִשָּׂא וְנוֹשֵׂא / מוֹשִׁיב מְלָכִים לַכִּסֵּא
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Powerful and exalted,
exalted above all rulers,
He fulfills His promises,
He is Fortress and Sanctuary,
He is lofty and bears aloft,
He seats kings on their thrones.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 147

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/147](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/147)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
גִּבּוֹר בִּגְבוּרוֹת / קֹרֵא הַדֹּרוֹת
גּוֹלֶה נִסְתָּרוֹת / אִמְרוֹתָיו טְהוֹרוֹת
יוֹדֵֽעַ סְפֹרוֹת / לְתוֹצְאוֹת מַזָּרוֹת
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Mighty in His great works,
He proclaims the future of all generations,
revealing that which is hidden, / His utterances are pure,
He knows the number of stars
and the composition of constellations.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 148

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/148](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/148)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
הַמְפֹאָר בְּפִי כֹל / וְהוּא כֹּל יָכוֹל
הַמְרַחֵם אֶת הַכֹּל / וְנוֹתֵן מִחְיָה לַכֹּל
וְנֶעְלָם מֵעֵין כֹּל / וְעֵינָיו מְשֹׁטְטוֹת בַּכֹּל
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Glorified on every tongue,
He is omnipotent,
He takes pity on all,
provides sustenance to all,
concealed from the eyes of all,
yet His eyes roam over all.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 149

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/149](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/149)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
זוֹכֵר נִשְׁכָּחוֹת / חוֹקֵר טֻחוֹת
עֵינָיו פְּקֻחוֹת / מַגִּיד שֵׂחוֹת
אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחוֹת / אִמְרוֹתָיו נְכֹחוֹת
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Recalls the forgotten, / examines innards,
His eyes are wide open, / He anticipates all thoughts,
God of spirits, / His words are truthful.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 150

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/150](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/150)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
טָהוֹר בִּזְבוּלָיו / אוֹת הוּא בְּאֶרְאֶלָּיו
אֵין עֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו / לִפְעֹל כְּמִפְעָלָיו
חוֹל שָׂם גְּבוּלָיו / כַּהֲמוֹת יָם לְגַלָּיו
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Pure in His heavenly abode,
Master of His angelic servants,
none can compare to Him / as He performs His works,
He placed sand as a border
against which the sea waves roar.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 151

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/151](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/151)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
כּוֹנֵס מֵי הַיָּם / רֹגַע גַּלֵּי יָם
סוֹעֵר שְׁאוֹן דָּכְיָם / מְלֹא הָעוֹלָם דַּיָּם
מַשְׁבִּיחָם בַּעְיָם / וְשָׁבִים אָחוֹר וְאַיָּם
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Gathers the waters of the sea,
stirs up the ocean waves,
causes the tumultuous waves to crash and break
till they are enough to fill the world,
yet He can quiet their power,
causing them to retreat till they cannot be found.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 152

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/152](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/152)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
מוֹשֵׁל בִּגְבוּרָה / דַּרְכּוֹ סוּפָה וּסְעָרָה
עוֹטֶה אוֹרָה / לַֽיְלָה כַּיּוֹם לְהָאִֽירָה
עֲרָפֶל לוֹ סִתְרָה / וְעִמֵּהּ שְׁרֵא נְהוֹרָא
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Rules with might, / His path is stormy and tempestuous,
clothed in light, / illuminating the night as day,
fog is His concealment, / yet light dwells with Him.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 153

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/153](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/153)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
סִתְרוֹ עָבִים / סְבִיבָיו לְהָבִים
רְכוּבוֹ כְּרוּבִים / מְשָׁרְתָיו שְׁבִיבִים
מַזָּרוֹת וְכוֹכָבִים / הִלּוּלוֹ מַרְבִּים
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Hidden in thick clouds, / flames surround Him,
His chariot is Cherubim, / His servants sparks of fire,
constellations and stars / praise Him exceedingly.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 154

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/154](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/154)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
פּוֹתֵֽחַ יָד וּמַשְׂבִּֽיעַ / צוֹרֵר מַֽיִם וּמַנְבִּֽיעַ
יַבֶּֽשֶׁת לְהַטְבִּֽיעַ / לִשְׁלִישׁ וְלִרְבִֽיעַ
יוֹם לְיוֹם יַבִּֽיעַ / שִׁבְחוֹ לְהַבִּֽיעַ
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Opens His hand and provides sustenance,
gathers up waters and causes them to flow,
washing over dry land / in shifts, by thirds and fourths,
each day expressions / of praise are mouthed.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 155

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/155](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/155)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא / בְּמוֹפֵת וּבְמוֹרָא
מְמַדֵּי אֶֽרֶץ קָרָא / וְאֶֽבֶן פִּנָּתָהּ יָרָה
וְכָל הַנִּבְרָא / לִכְבוֹדוֹ בָּרָא
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Sacred and awesome
with wonders and miraculous works,
He determined the dimensions of the earth
and laid its cornerstone,
and all that was created
was created for His glory.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 156

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/156](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/156)


מֶֽלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן
שוֹמֵֽעַ אֶל אֶבְיוֹנִים / וּמַאֲזִין חִנּוּנִים
מַאֲרִיךְ רְצוֹנִים / וּמְקַצֵּר חֲרוֹנִים
רִאשׁוֹן לָרִאשׁוֹנִים / וְאַחֲרוֹן לָאַחֲרוֹנִים
לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלֹךְ.


The Supreme King –
Heeds the destitute / and listens to supplication,
He extends goodwill / and limits wrath,
He is first of the first / and last of the last.
He shall reign forever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 158

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/158](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/158)


מֶֽלֶךְ אֶבְיוֹן
בָּלֶה וְרָד שַֽׁחַת / בִּשְׁאוֹל וּבְתַֽחַת / בְּלֵאוּת בְּלִי נַֽחַת
עַד מָתַי יִמְלֹךְ.


The destitute king
Worn and relegated to decay / in uppermost hell and beneath,
weary without rest –
till when shall he reign?


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 159

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/159](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/159)


מֶֽלֶךְ אֶבְיוֹן
תְּנוּמָה תְעוּפֶֽנּוּ / תַּרְדֵּמָה תְעוֹפְפֶֽנּוּ / תֹּֽהוּ יְשׁוּפֶֽנּוּ
עַד מָתַי יִמְלֹךְ.


The destitute king
Sleep hovers over him, / deep sleep enfolds him,
confusion overwhelms him –
till when shall he reign?


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 163

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/163](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/163)


יהוה מֶֽלֶךְ, יהוה מָלָךְ, יהוה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד.


The Lord is King, the Lord was King,
the Lord shall be King forever and ever.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 164

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/164](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/164)


כָּל שִׁנְאַנֵּי שַֽׁחַק בְּאֹֽמֶר מַאֲמִירִים יהוה מֶֽלֶךְ.
כָּל שׁוֹכְנֵי שֶֽׁקֶט בִּבְרָכָה מְבָרְכִים יהוה מָלָךְ.
אֵֽלּוּ וָאֵֽלּוּ בְּגֹֽבַהּ מַגְדִּילִים יהוה יִמְלֹךְ.


All the angels of heaven utter in praise,
The Lord is King.
All the residents of the silent earth blessedly exalt,

יִמְלֹךְ יהוה לְעוֹלָם, אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר, הַלְלוּיָהּ:


וְתִמְלֹךְ אַתָּה And You, LORD,
will rule alone over those You have made,
in Mount Zion, the dwelling of Your glory,
and in Jerusalem, Your holy city,
as it is written in Your holy writings:
“The LORD shall reign for ever.
He is your God, Zion, from generation to generation, Halleluya!”
Holiness of the day


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 210

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/210](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/210)


קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶֽךָ, וְאֵין אֱלֽוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ
כַּכָּתוּב, וַיִּגְבַּהּ יהוה צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט
וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדַּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ.


קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה You are holy, Your name is awesome,
and there is no god but You, as it is written,
“The LORD of hosts shall be raised up through His judgment,
the holy God, made holy in righteousness.”
Blessed are You, LORD, the holy King.

**קדושת היום**


**HOLINESS OF THE DAY**


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 212

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/212](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/212)


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים
אָהַֽבְתָּ אוֹתָֽנוּ וְרָצִֽיתָ בָּֽנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת
וְקִדַּשְׁתָּֽנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ, וְקֵרַבְתָּֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ קָרָֽאתָ.


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ You have chosen us from among all peoples.
You have loved and favored us. You have raised us above all tongues.
You have made us holy through Your commandments.
You have brought us near, our King, to Your service,
and have called us by Your great and holy name.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 213

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/213](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/213)


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה
אֶת יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה
יוֹם תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ, זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם.


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ And You, LORD our God, have given us in love
this Day of Remembrance,
a day of blowing the shofar,
a holy assembly in memory of the exodus from Egypt.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 214

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/214](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/214)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
יַעֲלֶה וְיָבוֹא וְיַגִּֽיעַ, וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע
וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵֽנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵֽנוּ וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִֽׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ, וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְפָנֶֽיךָ
לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה, לְחֵן וּלְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים, לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם
בְּיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה.
זָכְרֵֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה, וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה
וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים.
וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּֽנוּ, וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ
כִּי אֵלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ, כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
may there rise, come, reach, appear, be favored, heard,
regarded and remembered before You,
our recollection and remembrance,
as well as the remembrance of our ancestors,
and of the Messiah, son of David Your servant,
and of Jerusalem Your holy city,
and of all Your people the house of Israel –
for deliverance and well-being,
grace, loving-kindness and compassion,
life and peace, on this Day of Remembrance.
On it remember us, LORD our God, for good;
recollect us for blessing, and deliver us for life.
In accord with Your promise of salvation and compassion,
spare us and be gracious to us;
have compassion on us and deliver us, for our eyes are turned to You
because You, God, are a gracious and compassionate King.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 215

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/215](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/215)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
מְלֹךְ עַל כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בִּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ
וְהִנָּשֵׂא עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ בִּיקָרֶֽךָ
וְהוֹפַע בַּהֲדַר גְּאוֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ עַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל אַרְצֶֽךָ.
וְיֵדַע כָּל פָּעוּל כִּי אַתָּה פְעַלְתּוֹ, וְיָבִין כָּל יָצוּר כִּי אַתָּה יְצַרְתּוֹ
וְיֹאמַר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׁמָה בְּאַפּוֹ
יהוה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶֽלֶךְ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָֽׁלָה.
קַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
שַׂבְּעֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת, וּדְבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, מֶֽלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ
מְקַדֵּשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
rule over all the world in Your honor,
and be raised above all the earth in Your glory,
and appear, in the splendor of Your great might
before all those who live in this world, Your domain.
And all who were made will know that You made them,
and all who were formed will know that You formed them,
and all that have breath in their mouths will declare:
The LORD, God of Israel is King,
and His kingship has dominion over all.
Make us holy through Your commandments
and grant us our share in Your Torah.
Satisfy us with Your goodness,
grant us joy in Your salvation
and purify our hearts to serve You in truth.
For You, LORD, are truth, and Your word is truth
and holds true forever.
Blessed are You, LORD, King over all the earth,
who sanctifies Israel and the Day of Remembrance.

###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 217

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/217](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/217)


רְצֵה יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם
וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ
וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן
וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ.
וְתֶחֱזֶֽינָה עֵינֵֽינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.


רְצֵה Find favor, LORD our God,
in Your people Israel and their prayer.
Restore the service to Your most holy House,
and accept in love and favor
the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer.
May the service of Your people Israel
always find favor with You.
And may our eyes witness Your return to Zion in compassion.
Blessed are You, LORD, who restores His Presence to Zion.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 218

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/218](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/218)


**הודאה**


**THANKSGIVING**


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 220

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/220](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/220)


מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ
שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
צוּר חַיֵּֽינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ
אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר.
נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
עַל חַיֵּֽינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶֽךָ
וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ
וְעַל נִסֶּֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּֽנוּ
וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶֽיךָ
שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְצָהֳרָֽיִם.
הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וְהַמְרַחֵם, כִּי לֹא תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ
מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ.


מוֹדִים We give thanks to You,
for You are the LORD our God
and God of our ancestors
for ever and all time.
You are the Rock of our lives,
Shield of our salvation
from generation to generation.
We will thank You and
declare Your praise for our lives,
which are entrusted into Your hand;
for our souls,
which are placed in Your charge;
for Your miracles
which are with us every day;
and for Your wonders and favors
at all times, evening, morning and midday.
You are good –
for Your compassion never fails.
You are compassionate –
for Your loving-kindnesses never cease. We have always placed our hope in You.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 222

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/222](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/222)


מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ
שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
אֱלֹהֵי כָל בָּשָׂר
יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ, יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית.
בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת
לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ
עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָֽנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּֽנוּ.
כֵּן תְּחַיֵּֽנוּ וּתְקַיְּמֵֽנוּ
וְתֶאֱסֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵֽינוּ
לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּֽיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ וּלְעָבְדְּךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם
עַל שֶׁאֲנַֽחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ.
בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת.


מוֹדִים We give thanks to You,
for You are the LORD our God
and God of our ancestors,
God of all flesh,
who formed us
and formed the universe.
Blessings and thanks
are due to Your great
and holy name for giving us life and sustaining us.
May You continue
to give us life and sustain us;
and may You gather our exiles to Your holy courts,
to keep Your decrees,
do Your will and serve You with a perfect heart,
for it is for us
to give You thanks.
Blessed be God to whom thanks­giving is due.

אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, חָנֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ, כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶֽסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ.


Our Father, our King, be gracious to us and answer us, though we have no worthy deeds; act with us in charity and loving-kindness and save us.

###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Avinu Malkenu 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/51)


*ש״ץ:* יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא (*קהל:* אָמֵן)
בְּעָלְמָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ, וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ
בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל
בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן. (*קהל:* אָמֵן)


*Leader:* יִתְגַּדַּל Magnified and sanctified
may His great name be,
in the world He created by His will.
May He establish His kingdom
in your lifetime and in your days,
and in the lifetime of all the house of Israel,
swiftly and soon – and say: Amen.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Avinu Malkenu 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/52)


*קהל וש״ץ:* יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא.


*All:* May His great name be blessed for ever and all time.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Avinu Malkenu 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/53)


*ש״ץ:* יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא
וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל
שְׁמֵהּ דְּקֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא (*קהל:* בְּרִיךְ הוּא)
לְעֵֽלָּא לְעֵֽלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא
דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן. (*קהל:* אָמֵן)


*Leader:* Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted,
raised and honored, uplifted and lauded be
the name of the Holy One, blessed be He,
above and beyond any blessing,
song, praise and consolation
uttered in the world – and say: Amen.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Avinu Malkenu 54

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/54](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/54)


תִּתְקַבַּל צְלוֹתְהוֹן וּבָעוּתְהוֹן דְּכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל
קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁמַיָּא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן. (*קהל:* אָמֵן)
יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא
וְחַיִּים, עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן. (*קהל:* אָמֵן)


May the prayers and pleas of all Israel
be accepted by their Father in heaven – and say: Amen.
May there be great peace from heaven,
and life for us and all Israel – and say: Amen.
