אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ
וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל יוֹם יְהַלְלֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה.


אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ You are holy and Your name is holy,
and holy ones praise You daily, Selah!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/14)


וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ
וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ
וְיִירָאֽוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים, וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים
וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם
כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַֽעְנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ שֶׁהַשָּׁלְטָן לְפָנֶֽיךָ
עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ And so place the fear of You, LORD our God,
over all that You have made,
and the terror of You over all You have created,
and all who were made will stand in awe of You,
and all of creation will worship You,
and they will be bound all together as one
to carry out Your will with an undivided heart;
for we know, LORD our God,
that all dominion is laid out before You,
strength is in Your palm, and might in Your right hand,
Your name spreading awe over all You have created.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/15)


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יהוה לְעַמֶּֽךָ
תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶֽיךָ, וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ
וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ
שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶֽךָ, וְשָׂשׂוֹן לְעִירֶֽךָ
וּצְמִיחַת קֶֽרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ, וַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ
בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד And so place honor, LORD, upon Your people,
praise on those who fear You and hope into those who seek You,
the confidence to speak into all who long for You,
gladness to Your land and joy to Your city,
the flourishing of pride to David Your servant,
and a lamp laid out for his descendant, Your anointed, soon, in our days.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/16)


וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ
וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִֽילוּ, וְעוֹלָֽתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּֽיהָ
וְכָל הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כְּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה, כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶֽׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן הָאָֽרֶץ.


וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים And then righteous people will see and rejoice,
and the upright will exult, and the pious revel in joy,
and injustice will have nothing more to say,
and all wickedness will fade away like smoke
as You sweep the rule of arrogance from the earth.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/17)


וְתִמְלֹךְ אַתָּה יהוה לְבַדֶּֽךָ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ
בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ, וּבִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
יִמְלֹךְ יהוה לְעוֹלָם, אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר, הַלְלוּיָהּ:


וְתִמְלֹךְ אַתָּה And You, LORD,
will rule alone over those You have made,
in Mount Zion, the dwelling of Your glory,
and in Jerusalem, Your holy city,
as it is written in Your holy writings:
“The LORD shall reign for ever.
He is your God, Zion, from generation to generation, Halleluya!”
Holiness of the day


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/18)


קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶֽךָ, וְאֵין אֱלֽוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ
כַּכָּתוּב, וַיִּגְבַּהּ יהוה צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט
וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדַּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ.


קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה You are holy, Your name is awesome,
and there is no god but You, as it is written,
“The LORD of hosts shall be raised up through His judgment,
the holy God, made holy in righteousness.”
Blessed are You, LORD, the holy King.

###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/20)


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים
אָהַֽבְתָּ אוֹתָֽנוּ וְרָצִֽיתָ בָּֽנוּ
וְרוֹמַמְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת
וְקִדַּשְׁתָּֽנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ
וְקֵרַבְתָּֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ קָרָֽאתָ.


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ You have chosen us from among all peoples.
You have loved and favored us.
You have raised us above all tongues.
You have made us holy through Your commandments.
You have brought us near, our King, to Your service,
and have called us by Your great and holy name.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/21)


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה
אֶת יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה יוֹם תְּרוּעָה
מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ, זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם.


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ And You, LORD our God, have given us in love
this Day of Remembrance,
a day of blowing the shofar,
a holy assembly in memory of the exodus from Egypt.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/22)


וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵֽינוּ גָּלִֽינוּ מֵאַרְצֵֽנוּ, וְנִתְרַחַֽקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵֽנוּ
וְאֵין אֲנַֽחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲשׂוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתֶֽךָ
בַּבַּֽיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו
מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ.
יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, מֶֽלֶךְ רַחֲמָן
שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים
וְתִבְנֵֽהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ.
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵֽינוּ מְהֵרָה
וְהוֹפַע וְהִנָּשֵׂא עָלֵֽינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָּל חָי
וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵֽינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם, וּנְפוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ.


וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵֽינוּ But because of our sins we were exiled from our land
and driven far from our country.
We cannot perform our duties in Your chosen House,
the great and holy Temple that was called by Your name,
because of the hand that was stretched out against Your Sanctuary.
May it be Your will, LORD our God and God of our ancestors,
merciful King,
that You in Your abounding compassion may once more
have mercy on us and on Your Sanctuary,
rebuilding it swiftly and adding to its glory.
Our Father, our King, reveal the glory of Your kingdom to us swiftly.
Appear and be exalted over us in the sight of all that lives.
Bring back our scattered ones from among the nations,
and gather our dispersed people from the ends of the earth.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/23)


וַהֲבִיאֵֽנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה
וְלִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם
וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ
תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם
וְאֶת מוּסְפֵי יוֹם (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְיוֹם) הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה
נַעֲשֶׂה וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה כְּמִצְוַת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַֽבְתָּ עָלֵֽינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶֽךָ, כָּאָמוּר


וַהֲבִיאֵֽנוּ לְצִיּוֹן Lead us to Zion, Your city, in jubilation,
and to Jerusalem, home of Your Temple, with everlasting joy.
There we will prepare for You our obligatory offerings:
the regular daily offerings in their order
and the additional offerings according to their law.
And the additional offerings (of this Sabbath day and) of this
Day of Remembrance we will prepare and offer before You in love,
in accord with Your will’s commandment,
as You wrote for us in Your Torah
through Your servant Moses, by Your own word, as it is said:


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/24)


וּבַחֹֽדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹֽדֶשׁ מִקְרָא־קֹֽדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם, כָּל־מְלֶֽאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ, יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם עֹלָה לְרֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ לַיהוה, פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר אֶחָד, אַֽיִל אֶחָד, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם:


וּבַחֹֽדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי On the first day of the seventh month you shall hold a sacred assembly. You shall do no laborious work, and you shall mark a Day of the Blowing of the Shofar. You shall make a burnt-offering of pleasing aroma to the LORD: a young bullock, a ram, and seven yearling male lambs; they shall be without blemish.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/25)


וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר, שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָֽיִל, וְעִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ, וְיַֽיִן כְּנִסְכּוֹ, וּשְׁנֵי שְׂעִירִים לְכַפֵּר, וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם.


וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם And their meal offerings and wine-libations as ordained: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths of an ephah for the ram, one-tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs, wine for the libations, two male goats for atonement, and two regular daily offerings according to their law.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/26)


מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַחֹֽדֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָהּ, וְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ, וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם, לְרֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ, אִשֶּׁה לַיהוה:


מִלְּבַד All this aside from the burnt-offering of the New Moon and its meal-offering, and the regular daily burnt-offering with its meal-offering, and their libations according to their ordinance, a burnt-offering of pleasing odor to the LORD.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/27)


עָלֵֽינוּ לְשַׁבֵּֽחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל, לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית
שֶׁלֹּא עָשָֽׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת, וְלֹא שָׂמָֽנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה
שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵֽנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵֽנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם.
(שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהֶֽבֶל וָרִיק וּמִתְפַּלְלִים אֶל אֵל לֹא יוֹשִֽׁיעַ.)
וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים
לִפְנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַֽיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָֽרֶץ
וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל
וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים.
הוּא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, אֵין עוֹד.
אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, אֶֽפֶס זוּלָתוֹ
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ
וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל־לְבָבֶֽךָ
כִּי יהוה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל וְעַל־הָאָֽרֶץ מִתָּֽחַת, אֵין עוֹד׃


עָלֵֽינוּ It is our duty to praise the Master of all,
and ascribe greatness to the Author of creation,
who has not made us like the nations of the lands,
nor placed us like the families of the earth;
who has not made our portion like theirs,
nor our destiny like all their multitudes.
(For they worship vanity and emptiness,
and pray to a god who cannot save.)
But we bow in worship
and thank the Supreme King of kings, the Holy One, blessed be He,
who extends the heavens and establishes the earth,
whose throne of glory is in the heavens above,
and whose power’s Presence is in the highest of heights.
He is our God; there is no other.
Truly He is our King; there is none else,
as it is written in His Torah:
“You shall know and take to heart this day that the LORD is God,
in the heavens above and on the earth below.
There is no other.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/28)


עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְּךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶֽרֶת עֻזֶּֽךָ
לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָֽרֶץ, וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן
לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי.
וְכָל בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶֽךָ לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶֽיךָ כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָֽרֶץ.
יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל
כִּי לְךָ תִּכְרַע כָּל בֶּֽרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל לָשׁוֹן.
לְפָנֶֽיךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּֽלוּ, וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּֽנוּ
וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם אֶת עֹל מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ
וְתִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
יהוה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד׃


Therefore, we place our hope in You, LORD our God,
that we may soon see the glory of Your power,
when You will remove abominations from the earth,
and idols will be utterly destroyed,
when the world will be perfected
under the sovereignty of the Almighty,
when all humanity will call on Your name,
to turn all the earth’s wicked toward You.
All the world’s inhabitants will realize and know
that to You every knee must bow and every tongue swear loyalty.
Before You, LORD our God, they will kneel and bow down
and give honor to Your glorious name.
They will all accept the yoke of Your kingdom,
and You will reign over them soon and for ever.
For the kingdom is Yours,
and to all eternity You will reign in glory,
as it is written in Your Torah:
“The LORD will reign for ever and ever.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/29)


וְנֶאֱמַר
לֹא־הִבִּיט אָֽוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב, וְלֹא־רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל
יהוה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ, וּתְרוּעַת מֶֽלֶךְ בּוֹ:


And it is said:
He saw no injustice in Jacob, no deceit did He witness in Israel,
the Lord their God is with them,
and a King’s adulation resounds among them.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/30)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶֽלֶךְ, בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָֽאשֵׁי עָם
יַֽחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:


And it is said:
[The Lord] became King in Yeshurun,
when the heads of the people gathered,
all the tribes of Israel together.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/31)


וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
כִּי לַיהוה הַמְּלוּכָה וּמֹשֵׁל בַּגּוֹיִם׃


And in Your holy Writings it is said,
For kingship is the LORD’s
and He rules over the nations.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/32)


וְנֶאֱמַר
יהוה מָלָךְ, גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ
לָבֵשׁ יהוה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר, אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט׃


And it is said:
The LORD reigns. He is robed in majesty.
The LORD is robed, girded with strength.
The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/33)


וְנֶאֱמַר
שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם, וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם
וְיָבוֹא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד׃
מִי זֶה מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד, יהוה עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר
יהוה גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה׃
שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם, וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם
וְיָבֹא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד׃
מִי הוּא זֶה מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד
יהוה צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶֽלָה׃


And it is said:
Lift up your heads, O gates; be uplifted, eternal doors,
so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is the King of glory? It is the LORD, strong and mighty,
the LORD mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O gates; lift them up, eternal doors,
so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is He, the King of glory?
The LORD of hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah!


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/34)


וְעַל יְדֵי עֲבָדֶֽיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
כֹּה־אָמַר יהוה מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגֹאֲלוֹ, יהוה צְבָאוֹת
אֲנִי רִאשׁוֹן וַאֲנִי אַחֲרוֹן, וּמִבַּלְעָדַי אֵין אֱלֹהִים:


And by Your servants the prophets it is written:
This is what the Lord, King of Israel and its Savior,
the Lord of hosts has said:
“I am the first and I shall be the last,
and there is no other god but Me.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/35)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־הַר עֵשָׂו
וְהָיְתָה לַיהוה הַמְּלוּכָה׃


And it is said:
Saviors shall go up to Mount Zion
to judge Mount Esau,
and the Lord’s shall be the kingdom.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/36)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וְהָיָה יהוה לְמֶֽלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יהוה אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד׃


And it is said:
Then shall the Lord be King over all the earth.
On that day the Lord shall be One
and His name One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/37)


וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל, יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יהוה אֶחָד׃


And in Your Torah it is written:
Listen, Israel: the Lord is our God,
the Lord is One.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/38)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
מְלֹךְ עַל כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בִּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ
וְהִנָּשֵׂא עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ בִּיקָרֶֽךָ
וְהוֹפַע בַּהֲדַר גְּאוֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ עַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל אַרְצֶֽךָ.
וְיֵדַע כָּל פָּעוּל כִּי אַתָּה פְעַלְתּוֹ
וְיָבִין כָּל יָצוּר כִּי אַתָּה יְצַרְתּוֹ
וְיֹאמַר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׁמָה בְּאַפּוֹ
יהוה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶֽלֶךְ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָֽׁלָה.
קַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
שַׂבְּעֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת, וּדְבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, מֶֽלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ
מְקַדֵּשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
rule over all the world in Your honor,
and be raised above all the earth in Your glory,
and appear, in the splendor of Your great might
before all those who live in this world, Your domain.
And all who were made will know that You made them,
and all who were formed will know that You formed them,
and all that have breath in their mouths will declare:
The LORD, God of Israel is King,
and His kingship has dominion over all.
Make us holy through Your commandments
and grant us our share in Your Torah.
Satisfy us with Your goodness,
grant us joy in Your salvation
and purify our hearts to serve You in truth.
For You, LORD, are truth, and Your word is truth
and holds true forever.
Blessed are You, LORD,
King over all the earth,
who sanctifies Israel and the Day of Remembrance.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/40)


**זיכרונות**


**REMEMBRANCES**


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/41)


אַתָּה זוֹכֵר מַעֲשֵׂה עוֹלָם, וּפוֹקֵד כָּל יְצוּרֵי קֶֽדֶם
לְפָנֶֽיךָ נִגְלוּ כָּל תַּעֲלוּמוֹת וַהֲמוֹן נִסְתָּרוֹת שֶׁמִּבְּרֵאשִׁית
כִּי אֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ, וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ.
אַתָּה זוֹכֵר אֶת כָּל הַמִּפְעָל, וְגַם כָּל הַיְּצוּר לֹא נִכְחַד מִמֶּֽךָּ.
הַכֹּל גָּלוּי וְיָדֽוּעַ לְפָנֶֽיךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט עַד סוֹף כָּל הַדּוֹרוֹת
כִּי תָבִיא חֹק זִכָּרוֹן לְהִפָּקֵד כָּל רֽוּחַ וָנָֽפֶשׁ
לְהִזָּכֵר מַעֲשִׂים רַבִּים, וַהֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת לְאֵין תַּכְלִית.
מֵרֵאשִׁית כָּזֹאת הוֹדָֽעְתָּ, וּמִלְּפָנִים אוֹתָהּ גִּלִּֽיתָ.
זֶה הַיּוֹם תְּחִלַּת מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ, זִכָּרוֹן לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן
כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא, מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב:
וְעַל הַמְּדִינוֹת בּוֹ יֵאָמֵר
אֵיזוֹ לַחֶֽרֶב, וְאֵיזוֹ לַשָּׁלוֹם
אֵיזוֹ לָרָעָב, וְאֵיזוֹ לַשֹּֽׂבַע
וּבְרִיּוֹת בּוֹ יִפָּקֵֽדוּ, לְהַזְכִּירָם לְחַיִּים וְלַמָּֽוֶת.


אַתָּה זוֹכֵר You remember the making of the world;
You come to all those formed long ago.
Under Your gaze, all hidden things come to light,
all the many secrets buried since the Beginning.
For nothing is forgotten before the throne of Your glory,
and nothing is hidden from Your eyes.
You remember all of creation,
and all things that were formed – none is shrouded from You.
All is revealed and known before You, Lord our God,
who gazes and looks on to the last of all the ages.
For You bring a day decreed for remembrance
to come to each spirit and soul;
that Your many works be remembered,
Your numerous, endless creations.
From the very beginning You made it known,
long before this time You revealed it,
for this day is the opening of all Your works,
a remembrance of the very first day.
“For it is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.”
And on it, it is said of every province,
which will come to the sword and which to peace,
which will succumb to hunger and which find plenty.
And all creations are regarded on this day;
remembered for life, or for death.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/42)


מִי לֹא נִפְקַד כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה
כִּי זֵֽכֶר כָּל הַיְּצוּר לְפָנֶֽיךָ בָּא
מַעֲשֵׂה אִישׁ וּפְקֻדָּתוֹ, וַעֲלִילוֹת מִצְעֲדֵי גָֽבֶר
מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם וְתַחְבּוּלוֹתָיו, וְיִצְרֵי מַעַלְלֵי אִישׁ.
אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁכָּחֶֽךָּ, וּבֶן אָדָם יִתְאַמֶּץ בָּךְ
כִּי דוֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ לְעוֹלָם לֹא יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ
וְלֹא יִכָּלְמוּ לָנֶֽצַח כָּל הַחוֹסִים בָּךְ.
כִּי זֵֽכֶר כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים לְפָנֶֽיךָ בָּא, וְאַתָּה דוֹרֵשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה כֻלָּם.
וְגַם אֶת נֹֽחַ בְּאַהֲבָה זָכַֽרְתָּ, וַתִּפְקְדֵֽהוּ בִּדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים
בַּהֲבִיאֲךָ אֶת מֵי הַמַּבּוּל לְשַׁחֵת כָּל בָּשָׂר מִפְּנֵי רֹֽעַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם
עַל כֵּן זִכְרוֹנוֹ בָּא לְפָנֶֽיךָ, יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
לְהַרְבּוֹת זַרְעוֹ כְּעַפְרוֹת תֵּבֵל, וְצֶאֱצָאָיו כְּחוֹל הַיָּם.


מִי לֹא נִפְקַד Who may be overlooked on this day,
when the memory of every being formed comes before You? –
each person’s works, his purpose,
the path that he chooses and follows,
the thoughts and the plans of all mankind,
and the impulses behind each person’s acts?
Happy is the one who does not forget You,
the child of man who takes courage in You.
For one who seeks You will never stumble,
they need never be ashamed, who seek shelter in You.
For the memory of all that You have made passes before You,
You examine what each one does.
And Noah also, You remembered with love,
and You came to him with words of salvation, compassion,
when You brought on the waters of the great flood,
to destroy all creatures of flesh
because the practices they followed were corrupt.
And so let [Noah’s] memory come to You, Lord our God,
that You multiply His children like the dust of the earth,
his descendants like sand of the sea.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/43)


כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נֹֽחַ
וְאֵת כָּל־הַחַיָּה וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה
וַיַּעֲבֵר אֱלֹהִים רֽוּחַ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ, וַיָּשֹֽׁכּוּ הַמָּֽיִם:


As it is written in Your Torah:
“God remembered Noah and all the animals,
and all the cattle that were with him in the ark,
and God made a wind blow across the earth,
and the waters grew calm.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/44)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נַאֲקָתָם
וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ
אֶת־אַבְרָהָם אֶת־יִצְחָק וְאֶת־יַעֲקֹב:


And it is said:
“God heard their groaning,
and God remembered His covenant
with Abraham, with Isaac and with Jacob.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/45)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב
וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק, וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר
וְהָאָֽרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר:


And it is said:
“I will remember My covenant with Jacob,
and also My covenant with Isaac,
and also My covenant with Abraham I will remember,
and the land I will remember.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/46)


וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
זֵֽכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו, חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יהוה:


And in Your holy Writings it is written thus:
“He has made remembrance for His wonders;
gracious and compassionate is the Lord.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/47)


וְנֶאֱמַר
טֶֽרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו, יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:


And it is said:
“He has given food to those who revere Him;
He will remember His covenant forever.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/48)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ, וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חֲסָדָו:


And it is said:
“He remembered His covenant for their sake,
and relented in His great love.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/49)


וְעַל יְדֵי עֲבָדֶֽיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
הָלֹךְ וְקָרָֽאתָ בְאָזְנֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַֽם לֵאמֹר
כֹּה אָמַר יהוה
זָכַֽרְתִּי לָךְ חֶֽסֶד נְעוּרַֽיִךְ, אַהֲבַת כְּלוּלֹתָֽיִךְ
לֶכְתֵּךְ אַחֲרַי בַּמִּדְבָּר, בְּאֶֽרֶץ לֹא זְרוּעָה:


And by Your servants the prophets it is written:
“Go and call out to Jerusalem,
this is what the Lord has said:
‘I remember of you the kindness of your youth,
your love when you were a bride;
how you walked after Me in the desert,
through a land not sown.’”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/50)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וְזָכַרְתִּי אֲנִי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אוֹתָךְ בִּימֵי נְעוּרָֽיִךְ
וַהֲקִימוֹתִי לָךְ בְּרִית עוֹלָם:


And it is said:
“I will remember the covenant I had with you
in the days of your youth,
and I will establish with you an everlasting covenant.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/51)


וְנֶאֱמַר
הֲבֵן יַקִּיר לִי אֶפְרַֽיִם, אִם יֶֽלֶד שַׁעֲשׁוּעִים
כִּי־מִדֵּי דַבְּרִי בּוֹ, זָכֹר אֶזְכְּרֶֽנּוּ עוֹד
עַל־כֵּן הָמוּ מֵעַי לוֹ, רַחֵם אֲרַחֲמֶֽנּוּ נְאֻם־יהוה:


And it is said:
“Is Ephraim not a treasured son to Me, My child of delights?
As I speak of him, always, I remember him again.
And so it is that I long for him within,
I will tender him compassion, says the Lord.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/52)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, זָכְרֵֽנוּ בְּזִכְרוֹן טוֹב לְפָנֶֽיךָ
וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בִּפְקֻדַּת יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים מִשְּׁמֵי שְׁמֵי קֶֽדֶם
וּזְכָר לָֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
אֶת הַבְּרִית וְאֶת הַחֶֽסֶד וְאֶת הַשְּׁבוּעָה
אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִֽינוּ בְּהַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה
וְתֵרָאֶה לְפָנֶֽיךָ עֲקֵדָה
שֶׁעָקַד אַבְרָהָם אָבִֽינוּ אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ
וְכָבַשׁ רַחֲמָיו, לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם.
כֵּן יִכְבְּשׁוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ אֶת כַּעַסְךָ מֵעָלֵֽינוּ
וּבְטוּבְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יָשׁוּב חֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ מֵעַמְּךָ
וּמֵעִירְךָ וּמֵאַרְצְךָ וּמִנַּחֲלָתֶֽךָ.
וְקַיֶּם לָֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת הַדָּבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ, מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶֽךָ
כָּאָמוּר


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
remember us with a favorable memory,
and recall us with a remembrance of salvation and compassion from the highest ancient heaven.
Remember for our sake, Lord our God,
the covenant, the loving-kindness,
and the oath that You swore to Abraham our father
on Mount Moriah.
And let the image of that binding,
when our father Abraham bound Isaac his son upon the altar,
be present before You;
when he suppressed his compassion, to do Your will wholeheartedly.
So, too, let Your compassion wrest Your anger from us,
and in Your great goodness may Your anger be turned away from Your people, Your city, Your land and Your inheritance.
Fulfill for us, Lord our God, the promise You made in Your Torah,
at the hand of Moses Your servant and by Your own word,
as it is said:


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/53)


וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשֹׁנִים
אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵֽאתִי־אֹתָם מֵאֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם
לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים, אֲנִי יהוה:


“And I remembered, for their sake, the covenant of the early ones,
whom I brought out of the land of Egypt
before the eyes of all nations,
to be God to them, I am the Lord.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 54

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/54](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/54)


כִּי זוֹכֵר כָּל הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת אַתָּה הוּא מֵעוֹלָם
וְאֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ
וַעֲקֵדַת יִצְחָק לְזַרְעוֹ הַיּוֹם בְּרַחֲמִים תִּזְכֹּר.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, זוֹכֵר הַבְּרִית.


כִּי זוֹכֵר For it has always been You
who remembered all forgotten things,
and there is no forgetfulness before the throne of Your glory,
and today in Your compassion, You remember
the binding of Isaac, for his descendants’ sake.
Blessed are You, Lord, who remembers the covenant.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/56)


**שופרות**


**SHOFAROT**


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 57

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/57](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/57)


אַתָּה נִגְלֵֽיתָ בַּעֲנַן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ עַל עַם קָדְשְׁךָ לְדַבֵּר עִמָּם
מִן הַשָּׁמַֽיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּם קוֹלֶֽךָ, וְנִגְלֵֽיתָ עֲלֵיהֶם בְּעַרְפִלֵּי טֹֽהַר.
גַּם כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ חָל מִפָּנֶֽיךָ, וּבְרִיּוֹת בְּרֵאשִׁית חָרְדוּ מִמֶּֽךָּ
בְּהִגָּלוֹתְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עַל הַר סִינַי, לְלַמֵּד לְעַמְּךָ תּוֹרָה וּמִצְוֹת
וַתַּשְׁמִיעֵם אֶת הוֹד קוֹלֶֽךָ, וְדִבְּרוֹת קָדְשְׁךָ מִלַּהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ.
בְּקוֹלוֹת וּבְרָקִים עֲלֵיהֶם נִגְלֵֽיתָ, וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר עֲלֵיהֶם הוֹפָֽעְתָּ.


אַתָּה נִגְלֵֽיתָ You were revealed in a cloud of Your glory,
to Your holy nation, to speak with them.
Out of the heavens Your voice was heard;
You revealed Yourself in mists of purity.
And all the wide world quaked before You,
the works of creation shook in Your presence,
as You revealed Yourself, our King, on Mount Sinai,
to teach Your people Torah and the commandments,
to have them hear the majesty of Your voice –
Your sacred words amid flames of fire.
In thunder and lightning You revealed Yourself to them,
and amid the sound of the shofar You appeared.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 58

כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיֹת הַבֹּֽקֶר
וַיְהִי קֹלֹת וּבְרָקִים וְעָנָן כָּבֵד עַל־הָהָר
וְקֹל שֹׁפָר חָזָק מְאֹד, וַיֶּחֱרַד כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה:


As it is written in Your Torah:
“Then on the third day, in the morning –
thunder and lightning; heavy cloud covered the mountain,
there was a very loud sound of the shofar,
and all of the people in the camp quaked.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 59

וְנֶאֱמַר
וַיהִי קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד
מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר, וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶֽנּוּ בְקוֹל:


And it is said:
“And the sound of the shofar grew ever louder –
Moses spoke, and God answered him with a voice.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 60

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/60](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/60)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וְכָל־הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת־הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת־הַלַּפִּידִם
וְאֵת קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר, וְאֶת־הָהָר עָשֵׁן
וַיַּרְא הָעָם וַיָּנֻֽעוּ, וַיַּעַמְדוּ מֵרָחֹק:


And it is said:
“And all the people saw the thunder and the flames,
and the sound of the shofar, and the mountain asmoke;
the people saw and they staggered, and stood far back.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 61

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/61](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/61)


וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה, יהוה בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר:


And in Your holy Writings it is written thus:
“God has been raised up in sound:
raised, the Lord, in the voice of the shofar.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 62

וְנֶאֱמַר
בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר, הָרִֽיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יהוה:


And it is said:
“With trumpets and the sound of the shofar,
shout for joy before the Lord, the King.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 63

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/63](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/63)


וְנֶאֱמַר
תִּקְעוּ בַחֹֽדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר, בַּכֶּֽסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ:
כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא, מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב:


And it is said:
“Sound the shofar on the new moon,
on our feast day when the moon is hidden.
For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 64

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/64](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/64)


וְנֶאֱמַר
הַלְלוּיָהּ, הַלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַלְלֽוּהוּ בִּרְקִֽיעַ עֻזּוֹ׃
הַלְלֽוּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָיו הַלְלֽוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ׃
הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּתֵֽקַע שׁוֹפָר הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּנֵֽבֶל וְכִנּוֹר׃
הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעֻגָב׃
הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָֽׁמַע הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּצִלְצְלֵי תְרוּעָה׃
כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ
הַלְלוּיָהּ׃


And it is said:
“Halleluya! Praise God in His holy place;
praise Him in the heavens of His power.
Praise Him for His mighty deeds;
praise Him for His surpassing greatness.
Praise Him with blasts of the shofar;
praise Him with the harp and lyre.
Praise Him with timbrel and dance;
praise Him with strings and flute.
Praise Him with clashing cymbals;
praise Him with resounding cymbals.
Let all that breathes praise the LORD.
Halleluya!”

וְעַל יְדֵי עֲבָדֶֽיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל וְשֹֽׁכְנֵי אָֽרֶץ
כִּנְשֹׂא־נֵס הָרִים תִּרְאוּ, וְכִתְקֹֽעַ שׁוֹפָר תִּשְׁמָֽעוּ:


And by Your servants the prophets it is written:
“All the inhabitants of the world, all the dwellers on this earth,
when He lifts up a banner on the mountains, you will see it,
and when He sounds the shofar you shall hear.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 66

וְנֶאֱמַר
וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל
וּבָֽאוּ הָאֹבְדִים בְּאֶֽרֶץ אַשּׁוּר, וְהַנִּדָּחִים בְּאֶֽרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוה בְּהַר הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם:


And it is said:
“On that day a great shofar will be sounded,
and those who are lost will come from the land of Assyria,
and those who were banished, from the land of Egypt,
and they will worship the Lord at the holy mountain in Jerusalem.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 67

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/67](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Musaf/r/67)


וְנֶאֱמַר
וַיהוה עֲלֵיהֶם יֵרָאֶה, וְיָצָא כַבָּרָק חִצּוֹ
וַאדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה בַּשּׁוֹפָר יִתְקָע, וְהָלַךְ בְּסַעֲרוֹת תֵּימָן:
יהוה צְבָאוֹת יָגֵן עֲלֵיהֶם:
כֵּן תָּגֵן עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ.


And it is said:
“The Lord will appear to them,
His arrow will come out like lightning,
and the Lord God will sound the shofar,
and will move in stormwinds of the south.
The Lord of hosts will protect them –”
so, protect Your people Israel with Your peace.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Musaf 68

אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
תְּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל לְחֵרוּתֵֽנוּ, וְשָׂא נֵס לְקַבֵּץ גָּלֻיּוֹתֵֽינוּ
וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵֽינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם, וּנְפוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ.
וַהֲבִיאֵֽנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה
וְלִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם
וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ
כִּמְצֻוֶּה עָלֵֽינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ, מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶֽךָ
כָּאָמוּר


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
sound the great shofar for our freedom,
raise high the banner to gather our exiles,
bring close our scattered ones from among the nations,
and gather our exiles from the very ends of the earth.
Bring us to Zion, Your city, in joy,
and to Jerusalem, Your Temple, in everlasting happiness.
There we will prepare for You our obligatory offerings,
as we were commanded in Your Torah,
at the hand of Your servant Moses and by Your own word, as it is said:

וּבְיוֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶם וּבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם וּבְרָאשֵׁי חָדְשֵׁכֶם
וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּחֲצֹצְרֹת עַל עֹלֹתֵיכֶם וְעַל זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם
וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵיכֶם, אֲנִי יהוה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם:


On the days of your celebration,
and at your times of gathering and at your New Moons,
sound the trumpets over your offerings and over your peace-offerings,
and those days will be remembrance for you before your God,
I am the Lord your God.

כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ קוֹל שׁוֹפָר וּמַאֲזִין תְּרוּעָה, וְאֵין דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ.

כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ For You hear the call of the shofar,
and listen to its sounding, and there is none to be compared to You. Blessed are You, Lord, who listens to the sound of Your people Israel’s trumpet-blasts in compassion.

רְצֵה יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם
וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ
וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן
וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ.
וְתֶחֱזֶֽינָה עֵינֵֽינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.


רְצֵה Find favor, LORD our God,
in Your people Israel and their prayer.
Restore the service to Your most holy House,
and accept in love and favor the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer.
May the service of Your people Israel always find favor with You.
And may our eyes witness Your return to Zion in compassion.
Blessed are You, LORD, who restores His Presence to Zion.

מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ
שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
צוּר חַיֵּֽינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ, אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר.
נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
עַל חַיֵּֽינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶֽךָ
וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ
וְעַל נִסֶּֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּֽנוּ
וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְצָהֳרָֽיִם.
הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ
וְהַמְרַחֵם, כִּי לֹא תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ
מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ.
וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.


מוֹדִים We give thanks to You,
for You are the LORD our God and God of our ancestors
for ever and all time.
You are the Rock of our lives,
Shield of our salvation from generation to generation.
We will thank You and declare Your praise for our lives,
which are entrusted into Your hand;
for our souls, which are placed in Your charge;
for Your miracles which are with us every day;
and for Your wonders and favors
at all times, evening, morning and midday.
You are good – for Your compassion never fails.
You are compassionate – for Your loving-kindnesses never cease.
We have always placed our hope in You.
For all these things may Your name be blessed and exalted,
our King, continually, for ever and all time.

וּכְתֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ.
וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵֽנוּ סֶֽלָה.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת.


וּכְתֹב And write, for a good life, all the children of Your covenant.
Let all that lives thank You, Selah!
and praise Your name in truth,
God, our Savior and Help, Selah!
Blessed are You, LORD, whose name is “the Good”
and to whom thanks are due.

שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה
חֵן וָחֶֽסֶד וְרַחֲמִים
עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ.
בָּרְכֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ כֻּלָּֽנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ
כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ נָתַֽתָּ לָּֽנוּ, יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶֽסֶד
וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם.
וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל
בְּכָל עֵת וּבְכָל שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ.


שִׂים שָׁלוֹם Grant peace, goodness and blessing,
grace, loving-kindness and compassion to us
and all Israel Your people.
Bless us, our Father, all as one,
with the light of Your face,
for by the light of Your face
You have given us, LORD our God,
the Torah of life and love of kindness,
righteousness, blessing,
compassion, life and peace.
May it be good in Your eyes
to bless Your people Israel
at every time, in every hour, with Your peace.

אֱלֹהַי
נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה
וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדֹּם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה.
פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, וּבְמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי.
וְכָל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה
מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם.
עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ
עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן יְמִינֶֽךָ
עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶֽךָ
עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ.
לְמַֽעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶֽיךָ, הוֹשִֽׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ, יהוה צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי׃


אֱלֹהַי My God,
guard my tongue from evil and my lips from deceitful speech.
To those who curse me, let my soul be silent;
may my soul be to all like the dust.
Open my heart to Your Torah
and let my soul pursue Your commandments.
As for all who plan evil against me,
swiftly thwart their counsel and frustrate their plans.
Act for the sake of Your name;
act for the sake of Your right hand;
act for the sake of Your holiness;
act for the sake of Your Torah.
That Your beloved ones may be delivered,
save with Your right hand and answer me.
May the words of my mouth
and the meditation of my heart find favor before You,
LORD, my Rock and Redeemer.

עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו
הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.


May He who makes peace in His high places,
make peace for us and all Israel – and say: Amen.

יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
וְשָׁם נַעֲבָדְךָ בְּיִרְאָה כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמֹנִיּוֹת.
וְעָרְבָה לַיהוה מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמֹנִיּוֹת׃


יְהִי רָצוֹן May it be Your will, LORD our God and God of our ancestors,
that the Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days,
and grant us a share in Your Torah.
And there we will serve You with reverence,
as in the days of old and as in former years.
Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem
will be pleasing to the LORD as in the days of old and as in former years.

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב

וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה.


בָּרוּךְ Blessed are You, LORD our God and God of our fathers,
God of Abraham, God of Isaac and God of Jacob;
the great, mighty and awesome God, God Most High,
who bestows acts of loving-kindness and creates all,
who remembers the loving-kindness of the fathers
and will bring a Redeemer to their children’s children
for the sake of His name, in love.

and write us in the book of life – for Your sake, O God of life.
King, Helper, Savior, Shield:
Blessed are You, LORD, Shield of Abraham.

מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶֽסֶד, מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים

מִי כָמֽוֹךָ, בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרוֹת, וּמִי דּֽוֹמֶה לָּךְ

He sustains the living with loving-kindness,
and with great compassion revives the dead.
He supports the fallen,
heals the sick,
sets captives free,
and keeps His faith with those who sleep in the dust.
Who is like You, Master of might,
and who can compare to You,
O King who brings death and gives life,
and makes salvation grow?

לְאֵל עוֹרֵךְ דִּין לְבוֹחֵן לְבָבוֹת בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְגוֹלֶה עֲמֻקּוֹת בַּדִּין לְדוֹבֵר מֵישָׁרִים בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְהוֹגֶה דֵעוֹת בַּדִּין לְוָתִיק וְעוֹשֶׂה חֶֽסֶד בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְזוֹכֵר בְּרִיתוֹ בַּדִּין לְחוֹמֵל מַעֲשָׂיו בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְטַהֵר חוֹסָיו בַּדִּין לְיוֹדֵֽעַ מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּיוֹם דִּין לְכוֹבֵשׁ כַּעְסוֹ בַּדִּין לְלוֹבֵשׁ צְדָקוֹת בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְמוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת בַּדִּין לְנוֹרָא תְהִלּוֹת בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְסוֹלֵֽחַ לַעֲמוּסָיו בַּדִּין לְעוֹנֶה לְקוֹרְאָיו בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְפוֹעֵל רַחֲמָיו בַּדִּין לְצוֹפֶה נִסְתָּרוֹת בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְקוֹנֶה עֲבָדָיו בַּדִּין לְרַחֵם עַמּוֹ בְּיוֹם דִּין.
לְשׁוֹמֵר אֹהֲבָיו בַּדִּין לְתוֹמֵךְ תְּמִימָיו בְּיוֹם דִּין.


The God who renders judgment.
The One who examines hearts on the Day of Judgment.
The One who reveals deep secrets in judgment.
The One who speaks candidly on the Day of Judgment.
The One who voices His wisdom in judgment.
The One who is diligent and performs kindness
on the Day of Judgment.
The One who recalls His covenant in judgment.
The One who shows compassion toward His creations
on the Day of Judgment.
The One who purifies those who rely on Him in judgment.
The One who knows all inner thoughts on the Day of Judgment.
The One who suppresses His anger in judgment.
The One who clothes Himself with righteousness
on the Day of Judgment.
The One who forgives sins in judgment.
The awesome and praiseworthy One
on the Day of Judgment.
The One who forgives those He bears in judgment.
The One who answers those who call on Him
on the Day of Judgment.
The One who exercises His compassion in judgment.
The One who sees all hidden secrets on the Day of Judgment.
The One who acquires His servants in judgment.
The One who takes pity on His nation on the Day of Judgment.
The One who guards those who love Him in judgment.
The One who supports His innocent ones
on the Day of Judgment.

for You, our God, are King.

וּנְתַנֶּה תֹּֽקֶף קְדֻשַּׁת הַיּוֹם / כִּי הוּא נוֹרָא וְאָיֹם
וּבוֹ תִּנַּשֵּׂא מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ / וְיִכּוֹן בְּחֶֽסֶד כִּסְאֶֽךָ / וְתֵשֵׁב עָלָיו בֶּאֱמֶת.
אֱמֶת, כִּי אַתָּה הוּא דַיָּן וּמוֹכִֽיחַ, וְיוֹדֵֽעַ וָעֵד
וְכוֹתֵב וְחוֹתֵם וְסוֹפֵר וּמוֹנֶה
וְתִזְכֹּר כָּל הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת / וְתִפְתַּח אֶת סֵֽפֶר הַזִּכְרוֹנוֹת
וּמֵאֵלָיו יִקָּרֵא / וְחוֹתַם יַד כָּל אָדָם בּוֹ.


וּנְתַנֶּה תֹּֽקֶף Let us voice the power of this day’s sanctity –
it is awesome, terrible;
on this day Your kingship is raised,
Your throne is founded upon love,
and You, with truth, sit upon it.
In truth, it is You: Judge and Accuser, Knowing One and Witness,
writing and sealing, counting, numbering,
remembering all forgotten things,
You open the book of memories –
it is read of itself, / and every man’s name is signed there.

וּבְשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל יִתָּקַע / וְקוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה יִשָּׁמַע
וּמַלְאָכִים יֵחָפֵזוּן / וְחִיל וּרְעָדָה יֹאחֵזוּן
וְיֹאמְרוּ, הִנֵּה יוֹם הַדִּין / לִפְקוֹד עַל צְבָא מָרוֹם בַּדִּין

וּבְשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל A great shofar sounds,
and a still small voice is heard,
angels rush forward / and are held by trembling, shaking;
they say, “Here is the Day of Judgment
visiting all the heavenly host for judgment –”
for they are not cleared in Your eyes in judgment.
And all who have come into this world pass before You like sheep.

כֵּן תַּעֲבִיר וְתִסְפֹּר וְתִמְנֶה / וְתִפְקֹד נֶֽפֶשׁ כָּל חָי
וְתַחְתֹּךְ קִצְבָה לְכָל בְּרִיָּה / וְתִכְתֹּב אֶת גְּזַר דִּינָם.


כְּבַקָּרַת רוֹעֶה As a shepherd’s searching gaze meets his flock,
as he passes every sheep beneath his rod,
so You too pass Yours, count and number,
and regard the soul of every living thing;
and You rule off the limit of each creation’s life,
and write down the verdict for each.

בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יִכָּתֵבוּן / וּבְיוֹם צוֹם כִּפּוּר יֵחָתֵמוּן.
כַּמָּה יַעֲבֹרוּן וְכַמָּה יִבָּרֵאוּן
מִי יִחְיֶה וּמִי יָמוּת / מִי בְקִצּוֹ וּמִי לֹא בְקִצּוֹ
מִי בַמַּֽיִם וּמִי בָאֵשׁ / מִי בַחֶֽרֶב וּמִי בַחַיָּה / מִי בָרָעָב וּמִי בַצָּמָא
מִי בָרַֽעַשׁ וּמִי בַמַּגֵּפָה / מִי בַחֲנִיקָה וּמִי בַסְּקִילָה.
מִי יָנֽוּחַ וּמִי יָנֽוּעַ / מִי יַשְׁקִיט וּמִי יְטֹרַף
מִי יִשָּׁלֵו וּמִי יִתְיַסֵּר / מִי יַעֲנִי וּמִי יַעֲשִׁיר / מִי יֻשְׁפַּל וּמִי יָרוּם.


בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה On Rosh HaShana it is written / and on Yom Kippur it is sealed: / how many will pass away and how many will be born; / who will live and who will die; / who in his due time and who before; / who by water and who by fire; / who by sword and who by beast; / who of hunger and who of thirst; / who by earthquake and who by plague; / who by strangling and who by stoning; / who will rest and who will wander; / who will be calm and who will be harassed; / who will be at ease and who will suffer; / who will become poor and who will grow rich; / who cast down and who raised high.

כִּי לֹא תַחְפֹּץ בְּמוֹת הַמֵּת / כִּי אִם בְּשׁוּבוֹ מִדַּרְכּוֹ, וְחָיָה
וְעַד יוֹם מוֹתוֹ תְּחַכֶּה לּוֹ / אִם יָשׁוּב, מִיָּד תְּקַבְּלוֹ.
אֱמֶת, כִּי אַתָּה הוּא יוֹצְרָם / וְיוֹדֵֽעַ יִצְרָם / כִּי הֵם בָּשָׂר וָדָם.


כִּי כְשִׁמְךָ For as Your name is, so is Your renown:
hard to anger, and readily appeased.
For You do not desire the condemned man’s death,
but that he may come back from his ways, and live.
To the very day he dies, You wait for him;
and if he comes back: You welcome him at once.
Truly, it was You who formed them,
You know the forces moving them:/ they are but flesh and blood.

אֵין קִצְבָה There is no end to Your years,
no limit to the days of Your life.
One cannot grasp the measure of Your glorious chariot;
one may not articulate Your most concealed name.
Your name is befitting to You
and You befit Your name.
By that name You have named us.
Act for Your name’s sake.
Sanctify Your name
through those who sanctify Your name,
for the sake of the glory of Your name,
revered and sanctified,
with the words uttered by the holy Seraphim
who sanctify Your name in the Sanctuary,
those who live in heaven with those who live on earth
cry out and three times repeat
the threefold declaration of holiness to the Holy One,

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/51)


יִמְלֹךְ יהוה לְעוֹלָם, אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר, הַלְלוּיָהּ׃


“The LORD shall reign for ever.
He is your God, Zion, from generation to generation, Halleluya!”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/53)


לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלֶֽךָ, וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים קְדֻשָּׁתְךָ נַקְדִּישׁ
וְשִׁבְחֲךָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מִפִּֽינוּ לֹא יָמוּשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ אָֽתָּה.


From generation to generation we will declare Your greatness,
and we will proclaim Your holiness for evermore.
Your praise, our God, shall not leave our mouth forever,
for You, God, are a great and holy King.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 55

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/55](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/55)


חֲמֹל עַל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וְתִשְׂמַח בְּמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ
וְיֹאמְרוּ לְךָ חוֹסֶֽיךָ בְּצַדֶּֽקְךָ עֲמוּסֶֽיךָ
תֻּקְדַּשׁ אָדוֹן עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ


חֲמֹל Have mercy on those You have made,
take joy in those You made,
and those who shelter in You will say,
as You absolve the ones You bear,
“Be sanctified, Lord, through all that You have made.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/56)


כִּי מַקְדִּישֶֽׁיךָ בִּקְדֻשָּׁתְךָ קִדַּֽשְׁתָּ
נָאֶה לְקָדוֹשׁ פְּאֵר מִקְּדוֹשִׁים.


כִּי מַקְדִּישֶֽׁיךָ For with Your holiness You sanctify
all who affirm You holy;
it is fitting that the Holy One be glorified by holy ones.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 58

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/58](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/58)


וּבְכֵן יִתְקַדַּשׁ שִׁמְךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ
וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִירֶֽךָ
וְעַל צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
וְעַל מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ
וְעַל מְכוֹנְךָ וְהֵיכָלֶֽךָ.


וּבְכֵן יִתְקַדַּשׁ And so may Your name be sanctified, Lord our God,
through Israel Your nation
and Jerusalem, Your city,
and Zion, the dwelling place of Your honor
and through the royal house of David Your anointed,
and Your Sanctuary and Your Temple.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 59

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/59](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/59)


עוֹד יִזְכֹּר לָֽנוּ אַהֲבַת אֵיתָן, אֲדוֹנֵֽינוּ
וּבַבֵּן הַנֶּעֱקָד יַשְׁבִּית מְדַיְּנֵֽינוּ
וּבִזְכוּת הַתָּם יוֹצִיא הַיּוֹם לְצֶֽדֶק דִּינֵֽנוּ
כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ הַיּוֹם לַאֲדֹנֵֽינוּ:


He, our Lord,
will yet remember for us the love of [Abraham] the steadfast one.
And for [Isaac] the son who was bound,
He will still the enmity against us,
and for the merit of [Jacob] the innocent man,
He will bring today our judgment out to the good,
for this day is holy to our Lord.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 60

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/60](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/60)


בְּאֵין מֵלִיץ יֹֽשֶׁר מוּל מַגִּיד פֶּֽשַׁע
תַּגִּיד לְיַעֲקֹב דָּבָר, חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט
וְצַדְּקֵֽנוּ בַּמִּשְׁפָּט, הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַמִּשְׁפָּט.


With no one to advocate for us
against the accuser of sin,
speak words of law and of justice to Jacob;
and absolve us in the judgment, King of judgment.

הָאוֹחֵז בְּיָד מִדַּת מִשְׁפָּט
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא אֵל אֱמוּנָה.


הָאוֹחֵז בְּיָד The One who holds in His hand the trait of stern judgment.
And all believe that He is the faithful God.

הַבּוֹחֵן וּבוֹדֵק גִּנְזֵי נִסְתָּרוֹת
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא בּוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת.


The One who examines and scrutinizes the hidden stores.
And all believe that He examines the conscience of all.

הַגּוֹאֵל מִמָּֽוֶת וּפוֹדֶה מִשָּֽׁחַת
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא גּוֹאֵל חָזָק.


The One who redeems from death and ransoms from hell.
And all believe that He is a mighty Redeemer.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא דַּיַּן אֱמֶת.


The sole Judge of all who enter the world.
And all believe that He is a truthful Judge.

הֶהָגוּי בְּאֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה

The One whose name was pronounced “I will ever be what I am now.”
And all believe that He was, is, and shall forever be.

הַוַּדַּאי, כִּשְׁמוֹ כֵּן תְּהִלָּתוֹ
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא וְאֵין בִּלְתּוֹ.


The One whose praise is as affirmed as His name.
And all believe that He is One and there is no other.

הַזּוֹכֵר לְמַזְכִּירָיו טוֹבוֹת זִכְרוֹנוֹת
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא זוֹכֵר הַבְּרִית.


The One who recalls kindly those who utter His name.
And all believe that He recalls His covenant.

הַחוֹתֵךְ חַיִּים לְכָל חָי
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא חַי וְקַיָּם.


The One who allots life to all the living.
And all believe that He lives and is everlasting.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא טוֹב לַכֹּל.


The One who acts kindly with both the good and evil.
And all believe that He is kind to all.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא יוֹצְרָם בַּבָּֽטֶן.


The One who knows the devices of all creatures.
And all believe that He is the One who forms them in the womb.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא כֹּל יָכוֹל.


The One who is omnipotent and formed the world at once.
And all believe that He is all-powerful.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא לְבַדּוֹ הוּא.


The One who dwells concealed in His holy shade.
And all believe that He alone is God.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא מֶֽלֶךְ עוֹלָם.


The One who crowns kings yet the reign is His alone.
And all believe that He is an everlasting King.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא נוֹצֵר חֶֽסֶד.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא עוֹנֶה לָֽחַשׁ.


The lofty One whose eyes are turned to those who fear Him.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא פְּתוּחָה יָדוֹ.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא קָשֶׁה לִכְעֹס.

And all believe that His ire is hard to arouse.

וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא רַךְ לִרְצוֹת.

הַשָּׁוֶה, וּמַשְׁוֶה קָטֹן וְגָדוֹל
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹפֵט צֶֽדֶק.

הַתָּם, וּמִתַּמֵּם עִם תְּמִימִים
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא תָּמִים פָּעֳלוֹ.


The perfect One who deals in integrity with the innocent.
And all believe that His works are perfect and complete.

תֻּשְׂגַּב לְבַדֶּֽךָ, וְתִמְלֹךְ עַל כֹּל בְּיִחוּד
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ
וְהָיָה יהוה לְמֶֽלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יהוה אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד׃


תֻּשְׂגַּב לְבַדֶּֽךָ You will be elevated, peerless,
and will rule over all that is, alone,
as is written by Your prophet,
“Then the Lord shall be King over all the earth;
on that day the Lord shall be One and His name One.”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 87

וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ
וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ
וְיִירָאֽוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים, וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים
וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם
כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַֽעְנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ שֶׁהַשָּׁלְטָן לְפָנֶֽיךָ
עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ And so place the fear of You, LORD our God,
over all that You have made,
and the terror of You over all You have created,
and all who were made will stand in awe of You,
and all of creation will worship You,
and they will be bound all together as one
to carry out Your will with an undivided heart;
for we know, LORD our God,
that all dominion is laid out before You,
strength is in Your palm,
and might in Your right hand,
Your name spreading awe over all You have created.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 88

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/88](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/88)


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יהוה לְעַמֶּֽךָ
תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶֽיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ
וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ, שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶֽךָ, וְשָׂשׂוֹן לְעִירֶֽךָ
וּצְמִיחַת קֶֽרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ, וַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד And so place honor, LORD, upon Your people,
praise on those who fear You and hope into those who seek You,
the confidence to speak into all who long for You,
gladness to Your land, and joy to Your city,
the flourishing of pride to David Your servant,
and a lamp laid out for his descendant, Your anointed,
soon, in our days.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 89

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/89](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/89)


וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ
וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִֽילוּ, וְעוֹלָֽתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּֽיהָ
וְכָל הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כְּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה
כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶֽׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן הָאָֽרֶץ.


וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים And then righteous people will see and rejoice,
and the upright will exult, and the pious revel in joy,
and injustice will have nothing more to say,
and all wickedness will fade away like smoke
as You sweep the rule of arrogance from the earth.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 91

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/91](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/91)


וְיֶאֱתָֽיוּ כֹל לְעָבְדֶֽךָ / וִיבָרְכוּ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
וְיַגִּֽידוּ בָאִיִּים צִדְקֶֽךָ / וְיִדְרְשֽׁוּךָ עַמִּים לֹא יְדָעֽוּךָ
וִיהַלְלֽוּךָ כָּל אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ / וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יהוה
וְיִזְנְחוּ אֶת עֲצַבֵּיהֶם / וְיַחְפְּרוּ עִם פְּסִילֵיהֶם
וְיַטּוּ שְׁכֶם אֶחָד לְעָבְדֶֽךָ / וְיִירָאֽוּךָ עִם שֶֽׁמֶשׁ מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶֽיךָ
וְיַכִּֽירוּ כֹּֽחַ מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ / וְיִלְמְדוּ תוֹעִים בִּינָה
וִימַלְּלוּ אֶת גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ / וִינַשְּׂאֽוּךָ, מִתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ
וִיסַלְּדוּ בְחִילָה פָּנֶֽיךָ / וִיעַטְּרֽוּךָ נֵֽזֶר תִּפְאָרָה
וְיִפְצְחוּ הָרִים רִנָּה / וְיִצְהֲלוּ אִיִּים בְּמָלְכֶֽךָ
וִיקַבְּלוּ עֹל מַלְכוּתְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם / וִירוֹמְמֽוּךָ בִּקְהַל עָם
וְיִשְׁמְעוּ רְחוֹקִים וְיָבֽוֹאוּ / וְיִתְּנוּ לְךָ כֶּֽתֶר מְלוּכָה.


וְיֶאֱתָֽיוּ And all shall come forth to worship You
and they shall bless Your honorable name.
And they shall tell of Your righteousness in the islands,
and nations that have not known You shall seek You out.
And all the ends of the earth shall praise You
and shall always say, “May the Lord forever be exalted.”
And they shall spurn their idols
and be ashamed of their graven images.
And they shall turn their shoulder as one to worship You,
and those who seek Your presence
shall see You with the rising sun forever.
And they shall recognize Your majestic power,
and the errant ones shall learn to understand.
And they shall speak of Your might
and they shall exalt You who are exalted above all rulers.
And they shall leap back in fear in Your presence,
and they shall crown You with a diadem of glory.
And the mountains themselves shall break out in song,
and the islands shall joyfully shout as You are crowned.
And they shall accept the yoke of Your reign over them,
and You shall be exalted among assembled multitudes.
And they shall hear from far and wide and come
to offer You the royal crown.

וְתִמְלֹךְ אַתָּה יהוה לְבַדֶּֽךָ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ
בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ, וּבִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
יִמְלֹךְ יהוה לְעוֹלָם, אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר, הַלְלוּיָהּ:


וְתִמְלֹךְ And You, LORD, will rule alone over those You have made,
in Mount Zion, the dwelling of Your glory,
and in Jerusalem, Your holy city,
as it is written in Your holy Writings: “The LORD shall reign for ever.
He is your God, Zion, from generation to generation, Halleluya!”


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 93

קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶֽךָ, וְאֵין אֱלֽוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ
כַּכָּתוּב, וַיִּגְבַּהּ יהוה צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט
וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדַּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ.


קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה You are holy, Your name is awesome,
and there is no god but You, as it is written,
“The LORD of hosts shall be raised up through His judgment,
the holy God, made holy in righteousness.”
Blessed are You, LORD, the holy King.

**קדושת היום ומלכויות**


**HOLINESS OF THE DAY AND MALKHIYOT**


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 95

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/95](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/95)


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים
אָהַֽבְתָּ אוֹתָֽנוּ וְרָצִֽיתָ בָּֽנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת
וְקִדַּשְׁתָּֽנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְקֵרַבְתָּֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ קָרָֽאתָ.


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ You have chosen us from among all peoples.
You have loved and favored us. You have raised us above all tongues.
You have made us holy through Your commandments.
You have brought us near, our King, to Your service,
and have called us by Your great and holy name.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 96

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/96](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/96)


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה
אֶת יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה יוֹם תְּרוּעָה
מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ, זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם.


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ And You, LORD our God, have given us in love
this Day of Remembrance,
a day of blowing the shofar,
a holy assembly in memory of the exodus from Egypt.


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 97

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/97](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Rosh%20HaShana%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Second%20Day,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/97)


וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵֽינוּ גָּלִֽינוּ מֵאַרְצֵֽנוּ, וְנִתְרַחַֽקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵֽנוּ
וְאֵין אֲנַֽחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲשׂוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתֶֽךָ
בַּבַּֽיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו
מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ.
יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, מֶֽלֶךְ רַחֲמָן
שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים
וְתִבְנֵֽהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ.
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵֽינוּ מְהֵרָה
וְהוֹפַע וְהִנָּשֵׂא עָלֵֽינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָּל חָי
וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵֽינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם, וּנְפוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ.


וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵֽינוּ But because of our sins
we were exiled from our land
and driven far from our country.
We cannot perform our duties in Your chosen House,
the great and holy Temple that was called by Your name,
because of the hand that was stretched out against Your Sanctuary.
May it be Your will, LORD our God and God of our ancestors,
merciful King,
that You in Your abounding compassion may once more
have mercy on us and on Your Sanctuary,
rebuilding it swiftly and adding to its glory.
Our Father, our King,
reveal the glory of Your kingdom to us swiftly.
Appear and be exalted over us in the sight of all that lives.
Bring back our scattered ones from among the nations,
and gather our dispersed people from the ends of the earth.

וַהֲבִיאֵֽנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה
וְלִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם
וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ
תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם
וְאֶת מוּסְפֵי יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה
נַעֲשֶׂה וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה כְּמִצְוַת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַֽבְתָּ עָלֵֽינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶֽךָ, כָּאָמוּר


וַהֲבִיאֵֽנוּ לְצִיּוֹן Lead us to Zion, Your city, in jubilation,
and to Jerusalem, home of Your Temple, with everlasting joy.
There we will prepare for You our obligatory offerings:
the regular daily offerings in their order
and the additional offerings according to their law.
And the additional offerings of this
Day of Remembrance we will prepare and offer before You in love,
in accord with Your will’s commandment,
as You wrote for us in Your Torah
through Your servant Moses, by Your own word, as it is said:

וּבַחֹֽדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹֽדֶשׁ מִקְרָא־קֹֽדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם, כָּל־מְלֶֽאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ, יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם עֹלָה לְרֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ לַיהוה, פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר אֶחָד, אַֽיִל אֶחָד, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם:


וּבַחֹֽדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי On the first day of the seventh month you shall hold a sacred assembly. You shall do no laborious work, and you shall mark a Day of the Blowing of the Shofar. You shall make a burnt-offering of pleasing aroma to the LORD: a young bullock, a ram, and seven yearling male lambs; they shall be without blemish.

וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר, שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָֽיִל, וְעִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ, וְיַֽיִן כְּנִסְכּוֹ, וּשְׁנֵי שְׂעִירִים לְכַפֵּר, וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם.


וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם And their meal offerings and wine-libations as ordained: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths of an ephah for the ram, one-tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs, wine for the libations, two male goats for atonement, and two regular daily offerings according to their law.

מִלְּבַד All this aside from the burnt-offering of the New Moon and its meal-offering, and the regular daily burnt-offering with its meal-offering, and their libations according to their ordinance, a burnt-offering of pleasing odor to the LORD.

עָלֵֽינוּ לְשַׁבֵּֽחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל, לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית
שֶׁלֹּא עָשָֽׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת, וְלֹא שָׂמָֽנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה


עָלֵֽינוּ It is our duty to praise the Master of all,
and ascribe greatness to the Author of creation,
who has not made us like the nations of the lands,
nor placed us like the families of the earth;


###### The Koren Rosh HaShana Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Second Day, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 105

שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵֽנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵֽנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם.
(שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהֶֽבֶל וָרִיק וּמִתְפַּלְלִים אֶל אֵל לֹא יוֹשִֽׁיעַ.)


who has not made our portion like theirs,
nor our destiny like all their multitudes.
(For they worship vanity and emptiness,
and pray to a god who cannot save.)

וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים
לִפְנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַֽיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָֽרֶץ
וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל
וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים.


But we bow in worship
and thank the Supreme King of kings, the Holy One, blessed be He,
who extends the heavens and establishes the earth,
whose throne of glory is in the heavens above,
and whose power’s Presence is in the highest of heights.
